Operating Within the Operational Design Domain: Zero-Shot Perception with Vision-Language Models AutonomousDriving

Operational Design Domain Vision-Language Models Zero-shot perception Automated Driving Systems ODD classification

简要说明：本文评估了视觉语言模型作为自动驾驶感知中零样本'运行设计域传感器'的能力，贡献了一项实证研究、优化策略和可复用的提示模板。

TLDR: This paper evaluates Vision-Language Models as zero-shot 'Operational Design Domain sensors' for autonomous driving perception, contributing an empirical study, optimization strategies, and reusable prompting templates.

Abstract: Over the last few years, research on autonomous systems has matured to such a degree that the field is increasingly well-positioned to translate research into practical, stakeholder-driven use cases across well-defined domains. However, for a wide-scale practical adoption of autonomous systems, adherence to safety regulations is crucial. Many regulations are influenced by the Operational Design Domain (ODD), which defines the specific conditions in which an autonomous agent can function. This is especially relevant for Automated Driving Systems (ADS), as a dependable perception of ODD elements is essential for safe implementation and auditing. Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual recognition and language reasoning, functioning without task-specific training data, which makes them suitable for adaptable ODD perception. To assess whether VLMs can function as zero-shot "ODD sensors" that adapt to evolving definitions, we contribute (i) an empirical study of zero-shot ODD classification and detection using four VLMs on a custom dataset and Mapillary Vistas, along with failure analyses; (ii) an ablation of zero-shot optimization strategies with a cost-performance overview; and (iii) a suite of reusable prompting templates with guidance for adaptation. Our findings indicate that definition-anchored chain-of-thought prompting with persona decomposition performs best, while other methods may result in reduced recall. Overall, our results pave the way for transparent and effective ODD-based perception in safety-critical applications.

摘要（中文）：在过去的几年中，关于自主系统的研究已经发展到相当成熟的阶段，该领域越来越能够将研究成果转化为特定领域内由利益相关者驱动的实际应用案例。然而，要实现自主系统的广泛应用，遵守安全法规至关重要。许多法规受到运行设计域（ODD）的影响，该域定义了自主代理能够运行的具体条件。这对于自动驾驶系统（ADS）尤为关键，因为对ODD要素的可靠感知是安全实施与审计的基础。视觉语言模型（VLMs）整合了视觉识别与语言推理能力，无需特定任务的训练数据即可运行，这使其适用于适应性强的ODD感知任务。为了评估VLM是否能够作为适应动态定义的零样本“ODD传感器”，本文贡献如下：（1）基于定制数据集和Mapillary Vistas，利用四种VLM进行零样本ODD分类与检测的实证研究，并辅以失败案例分析；（2）通过成本-性能综合评估对零样本优化策略进行消融实验；（3）一套可复用的提示模板及其适配指导。研究发现，采用基于定义的思维链提示与角色分解的方法表现最佳，而其他方法可能导致召回率下降。总体而言，我们的研究结果为安全关键应用领域实现透明高效的基于ODD的感知提供了技术路径。

Authors: Berkehan Ünal, Dierend Hauke, Fazlija Dren, Plachetka Christopher

BrickCraft: Visuomotor Skill Composition with Situated Manual Guidance for Long-Horizon Interlocking Brick Assembly Manipulation

robotic assembly visuomotor skills compositional framework situated manuals long-horizon tasks

简要说明：BrickCraft 是一个用于互锁积木机器人装配的组合框架，它将任务分解为原始技能，通过现场手册将装配意图投影到实时观测中，并链式执行技能以完成长时程装配。

TLDR: BrickCraft is a compositional framework for robotic assembly of interlocking bricks that decomposes tasks into primitive skills, uses situated manuals to project assembly intent onto real-time observations, and chains skills for long-horizon structures.

Abstract: Autonomous robotic assembly of interlocking bricks demands seamless integration of long-horizon task reasoning, spatial grounding, and fine-grained manipulation. This paper presents BrickCraft, a compositional framework designed for long-horizon and generalizable interlocking brick assembly. BrickCraft models the assembly process using a relative formulation, where each step is anchored to a reference brick within the partial structure, thereby decomposing complex tasks into a finite set of reusable primitive skills. BrickCraft bridges the gap between high-level assembly plans and physical execution through situated manuals, which provide explicit spatial guidance for learned visuomotor skills by projecting the assembly intent onto real-time robot observations. Finally, BrickCraft employs a compositional execution pipeline that chains these spatially grounded skills to accomplish long-horizon assembly tasks. Extensive experimental validations demonstrate that BrickCraft acquires proficient assembly skills from a limited set of demonstrations and exhibits strong compositional generalization to unseen structures. The project website is available at https://intelligent-control-lab.github.io/BrickCraft.

摘要（中文）：互锁砖块自主机器人组装需要长周期任务推理、空间定位与精细化操作的深度融合。本文提出BrickCraft——一个专为长周期、可泛化互锁砖块组装设计的组合式框架。该框架采用相对建模方法描述装配过程，每个步骤均以局部结构中的参考砖块为锚点，从而将复杂任务分解为有限可重复使用的基元技能组合。通过"情境化操作手册"技术，BrickCraft将装配意图映射至实时机器人观测数据，为习得的视觉运动技能提供明确的空间引导，弥合了高层装配规划与物理执行之间的鸿沟。最终，该框架采用组合式执行管道，将空间定位技能串联以实现长周期装配任务。大量实验验证表明，BrickCraft仅需少量示范即可掌握熟练装配技能，并对未见结构展现出强大的组合泛化能力。项目网站详见：https://intelligent-control-lab.github.io/BrickCraft。

Authors: Jichuan Yu, Bowei Li, Zhenran Tang, Guanxing Lu, Chuxiong Hu, Ruixuan Liu, Changliu Liu

MORPH-U: Multi-Objective Resilient Motion Planning for V2X-Enabled Autonomous Driving in High-Uncertainty Environments via Simulation AutonomousDriving

V2X-enabled autonomous driving motion planning multi-objective optimization Local Dynamic Map Byzantine-inspired acceptance gate

简要说明：本文提出MORPH-U，一个融合V2X和车载传感器的闭环自动驾驶系统，通过多目标优化分析规划/控制权衡，并采用轻量级拜占庭式门控机制来应对V2X通信中的不确定性。

TLDR: The paper presents MORPH-U, a closed-loop autonomous driving stack that fuses V2X and onboard sensors for robust motion planning, introduces a multi-objective trade-off analysis for planning/control, and a lightweight Byzantine-inspired gate to mitigate V2X uncertainty.

Abstract: V2X can warn an autonomous vehicle about hazards beyond line-of-sight, but it also brings uncertainty: messages may be delayed, dropped, or even forged. Meanwhile, map knowledge may change during a trip, forcing the vehicle to replan under tight real-time budgets. This paper studies how to make motion planning and low-level control robust to such uncertain, event-driven updates. We present MORPH-U, a CARLA-based closed-loop stack that fuses LiDAR/radar/camera with V2X (CAM/DENM) into a Local Dynamic Map (LDM) and triggers Hybrid-A* replanning when validated hazards or map changes affect the planned route. We expose the planning/control trade-offs via a multi-objective formulation over tracking error, safety margin (minimum TTC), responsiveness, and smoothness, and select operating points using Pareto-frontier analysis. To avoid unsafe replanning from faulty V2X triggers, MORPH-U adds a lightweight Byzantine-inspired acceptance gate that combines a quorum rule with an on-board sensor veto. Experiments in dynamic CARLA scenarios show that V2X-augmented LDM improves downstream safety, Pareto tuning provides controllable accuracy-comfort trade-offs, and the gate prevents replanning under saturated false-DENM injection ($p_{\text{attack}}=1.0$).

摘要（中文）：V2X能够在视线范围之外向自动驾驶车辆预警潜在危险，但同时也引入了不确定性：消息可能延迟、丢失甚至被篡改。与此同时，地图信息可能在行驶过程中发生变化，迫使车辆在严格的实时预算下进行重新规划。本文研究了如何使运动规划与底层控制对此类不确定的事件驱动更新具有鲁棒性。我们提出了MORPH-U——一个基于CARLA的闭环系统，该系统将激光雷达/毫米波雷达/摄像头数据与V2X（CAM/DENM）融合至局部动态地图（LDM），并在经过验证的危险事件或地图变化影响预设路线时触发混合A*算法进行重规划。我们通过建立跟踪误差、安全裕度（最小碰撞时间）、响应速度和平顺性等多目标优化模型，揭示了规划与控制之间的权衡关系，并利用帕累托前沿分析选择最优工作点。为避免因错误V2X触发导致不安全的重新规划，MORPH-U增设了轻量级拜占庭式验收门控机制，该机制融合了多数表决规则与车载传感器否决权。在动态CARLA场景中的实验表明：V2X增强的局部动态地图提升了下游安全性，帕累托调优实现了可控的精度与舒适度权衡，而验收门控机制能在虚假DENM消息满量注入攻击（$p_{\text{攻击}}=1.0$）时有效阻止重规划。

Authors: Shih-Yu Lai

AT-VLA: Adaptive Tactile Injection for Enhanced Feedback Reaction in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

tactile feedback manipulation dual-stream real-time adaptive injection

简要说明：本文提出了AT-VLA，一种具有自适应触觉注入机制和双流架构的VLA模型，用于在接触丰富的操作任务中实现实时触觉反馈。

TLDR: The paper proposes AT-VLA, a VLA model with an adaptive tactile injection mechanism and a dual-stream architecture for real-time tactile feedback in contact-rich manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have significantly advanced the capabilities of robotic agents in executing diverse tasks; however, they still face challenges in contact-rich manipulation scenarios that require precise physical interactions. To address this limitation, recent studies have attempted to incorporate tactile signals during downstream tasks, enabling pretrained VLAs to interpret tactile feedback. Nevertheless, introducing new modalities during finetuning, which are rarely present in the pretrain stage, may disrupt the pretrained capabilities of VLAs. In addition, the inherently slow inference speed of VLAs hampers real-time responsiveness and limits the effective utilization of tactile feedback for action adjustment. To overcome these challenges, we propose Adaptive Tactile Vision-Language-Action (AT-VLA), which introduces a novel Adaptive Tactile Injection mechanism. This mechanism dynamically determines the appropriate timing and locations for tactile injection, incorporating only when it significantly contributes to action generation, thereby minimizing interference with pretrained representations. Furthermore, to enable rapid and accurate tactile responses, we propose a Tactile Reaction Dual-Stream mechanism, which decouples sensory processing into a slow visual-language stream for low-frequency perceptual reasoning and a fast tactile control stream for high-frequency physical interaction understanding, achieving real-time close-loop responses within 0.04 s. Real-world experiments thoroughly validate the effectiveness of AT-VLA in contact-rich manipulation tasks. The project page is available at: https://sites.google.com/view/at-vla.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型显著提升了机器人在执行多样化任务中的能力，但在需要精确物理交互的密集接触操作场景中仍面临挑战。为突破这一局限，近期研究尝试在下游任务中引入触觉信号，使预训练VLA模型能够解读触觉反馈。然而，在微调阶段引入预训练阶段极少出现的新模态可能会干扰VLA的预训练能力。此外，VLA模型固有的缓慢推理速度限制了实时响应性，并制约了触觉反馈在动作调整中的有效利用。为应对这些挑战，我们提出自适应触觉视觉-语言-动作模型（AT-VLA），该模型引入了一种新颖的自适应触觉注入机制。该机制能动态确定触觉注入的恰当时机与位置，仅当触觉信息对动作生成有显著贡献时才予以融合，从而最大限度地减少对预训练表征的干扰。同时，为实现快速精准的触觉响应，我们提出了触觉反应双流处理机制，将感知处理解耦为低频感知推理的慢速视觉-语言流，以及用于高频物理交互理解的快速触觉控制流，最终在0.04秒内实现实时闭环响应。真实世界实验充分验证了AT-VLA在密集接触操作任务中的有效性。项目页面详见：https://sites.google.com/view/at-vla。

Authors: Xiaoqi Li, Muhe Cai, Jiadong Xu, Juan Zhu, Hongwei Fan, Yan Shen, Guangrui Ren, Hao Dong

Traffic Scenario Orchestration from Language via Constraint Satisfaction AutonomousDriving

scenario orchestration constraint satisfaction closed-loop testing autonomous vehicles language descriptions

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶闭环测试的语言输入、仿真输出场景编排器，利用基础模型将自然语言描述转化为约束，并使用现成求解器生成满足测试意图的智能体行为。

TLDR: The paper presents a language-in, simulation-out scenario orchestrator for closed-loop testing of autonomous vehicles, using foundation models to translate natural language descriptions into constraints and off-the-shelf solvers to generate actor behaviors.

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) require extensive testing in simulation, but test case generation for driving scenarios is laborious. The desired scenarios are often out-of-distribution and have precise requirements on interactions with the AV policy under test. Manually programming scenarios allows for precise controllability but is difficult to scale. On the other hand, statistical models can leverage compute and data, but struggle with precise controllability when out-of-distribution. We cast scenario orchestration as a constraint-solving problem and present a language-in, simulation-out scenario orchestrator for closed-loop testing AVs. Our approach leverages foundation model reasoning to translate general, natural language descriptions into a set of constraints as a scenario representation. This then allows us to leverage off the shelf solvers to solve for actor behaviors which meet precise testing intentions in closed-loop. Under a benchmark of carefully crafted and diverse scenario descriptions, our approach greatly outperforms our baselines in orchestration success rate. We further show that our closed-loop approach is especially important for scenarios which require ego-reactive specifications.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶车辆需要在仿真环境中进行大量测试，然而驾驶场景的测试用例生成过程繁琐耗时。理想的测试场景往往属于分布外数据，且对被测自动驾驶策略的交互行为有精确要求。手动编程场景虽能实现精确控制，但难以规模化扩展。另一方面，统计模型虽能充分利用计算资源和数据，但在处理分布外数据的精确可控性方面存在局限。我们将场景编排构建为约束求解问题，提出一种基于"语言输入-仿真输出"的闭环自动驾驶测试场景编排器。该方法利用基础模型的推理能力，将通用的自然语言描述转化为约束集合作为场景表征，进而借助现成求解器推导出符合闭环测试精确意图的交通参与者行为。在精心设计的多样化场景描述基准测试中，本方法的编排成功率显著优于基线模型。我们进一步证明，对于需要自车反应式规约的场景，这种闭环测试方法具有特殊重要性。

Authors: Frieda Rong, Chris Zhang, Kelvin Wong, Raquel Urtasun

ForgeVLA: Federated Vision-Language-Action Learning without Language Annotations VLA

Federated Learning Vision-Language-Action Instruction Classifier Contrastive Planning Loss Adaptive Aggregation

简要说明：ForgeVLA是一个联邦学习框架，通过客户端指令分类器从分布式视觉-动作数据中构建VLA三元组，并通过对比损失和自适应聚合解决特征崩溃问题。

TLDR: ForgeVLA is a federated learning framework that constructs Vision-Language-Action (VLA) triplets from distributed vision-action data using a client-side instruction classifier, and addresses feature collapse with a contrastive loss and adaptive aggregation.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models hold great promise for general-purpose robotic intelligence, yet scaling up such models is severely bottlenecked by the high cost of acquiring annotated training data. Fortunately, vision-equipped robots deployed across various domains already produce abundant vision-action pairs that can be leveraged to scale up VLA training more efficiently. However, these raw data cannot be centrally aggregated due to various constraints and also exhibit severe heterogeneity. To address these challenges, in this paper, we propose ForgeVLA, a federated VLA training framework that learns VLA models from distributed vision-action pairs without centralizing raw data or requiring manual annotations. Specifically, each client in ForgeVLA is equipped with an embodied instruction classifier that maps vision-action pairs to a predefined instruction set, recovering the missing language modality and forming complete vision-language-action triplets. Beyond triplet construction, we also identify vision-language feature collapse as a critical challenge that has been largely overlooked in prior federated VLA research. To mitigate this issue, ForgeVLA combines a client-side contrastive planning loss with a server-side adaptive aggregation strategy to learn task-discriminative representations efficiently. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that ForgeVLA significantly outperforms other baselines, and ablation studies further validate the contribution of each component.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在实现通用机器人智能方面展现出巨大潜力，但获取标注训练数据的高成本严重制约了此类模型的规模化扩展。幸运的是，部署于各类场景的视觉机器人已能持续产生丰富的视觉-动作配对数据，为高效扩展VLA训练提供了可能。然而，这些原始数据因各类限制无法集中聚合，且存在显著的异构性。为应对这些挑战，本文提出ForgeVLA——一个联邦化VLA训练框架，该框架能够基于分布式视觉-动作数据学习VLA模型，无需集中原始数据或依赖人工标注。具体而言，ForgeVLA中的每个客户端配备具身指令分类器，将视觉-动作对映射至预设指令集，从而补全缺失的语言模态，形成完整的视觉-语言-动作三元组。除三元组构建外，我们还发现视觉-语言特征坍缩是现有联邦VLA研究中长期被忽视的关键问题。为此，ForgeVLA通过客户端对比规划损失与服务器端自适应聚合策略相结合的方式，有效学习任务判别性表征。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，ForgeVLA显著优于现有基线方法，消融实验进一步验证了各模块的有效性。

Authors: Yuhao Zhou, Yunpeng Zhu, Yang Zhou, Jindi Lyu, Jian Lan, Zhangyuan Wang, Dan Si, Thomas Seidl, Qing Ye, Jiancheng Lyu

123D: Unifying Multi-Modal Autonomous Driving Data at Scale AutonomousDriving

autonomous driving multi-modal data dataset unification 3D object detection reinforcement learning planning

简要说明：123D是一个开源框架，通过单一API统一多模态自动驾驶数据集，实现跨数据流的同步/异步访问，并展示了在跨数据集3D物体检测和规划强化学习中的应用。

TLDR: 123D is an open-source framework that unifies multi-modal autonomous driving datasets through a single API, enabling synchronous/asynchronous access across data streams and showcasing applications in cross-dataset 3D object detection and RL for planning.

Abstract: The pursuit of autonomous driving has produced one of the richest sensor data collections in all of robotics. However, its scale and diversity remain largely untapped. Each dataset adopts different 2D and 3D modalities, such as cameras, lidar, ego states, annotations, traffic lights, and HD maps, with different rates and synchronization schemes. They come in fragmented formats requiring complex dependencies that cannot natively coexist in the same development environment. Further, major inconsistencies in annotation conventions prevent training or measuring generalization across multiple datasets. We present 123D, an open-source framework that unifies such multi-modal driving data through a single API. To handle synchronization, we store each modality as an independent timestamped event stream with no prescribed rate, enabling synchronous or asynchronous access across arbitrary datasets. Using 123D, we consolidate eight real-world driving datasets spanning 3,300 hours and 90,000 kilometers, together with a synthetic dataset with configurable collection scripts, and provide tools for data analysis and visualization. We conduct a systematic study comparing annotation statistics and assessing each dataset's pose and calibration accuracy. Further, we showcase two applications 123D enables: cross-dataset 3D object detection transfer and reinforcement learning for planning, and offer recommendations for future directions. Code and documentation are available at https://github.com/kesai-labs/py123d.

摘要（中文）：对自动驾驶的追求催生了机器人领域最为丰富的传感器数据收集之一。然而，其规模与多样性在很大程度上尚未得到充分利用。各数据集采用不同的二维与三维模态——如相机、激光雷达、自车状态、标注数据、交通信号灯及高精地图，且数据采集频率与同步方案各异。这些数据以碎片化格式存储，需要复杂的依赖环境，难以原生共存于同一开发平台。此外，标注规范的重大不一致性阻碍了跨数据集训练或泛化能力评估。本文提出123D——一个通过统一API整合多模态驾驶数据的开源框架。为处理同步问题，我们将每种模态存储为独立的带时间戳事件流，无需预设采集频率，从而支持跨任意数据集的同步或异步访问。基于123D，我们整合了八个真实世界驾驶数据集（总计3300小时、9万公里行程）以及一个可配置采集脚本的合成数据集，并提供数据分析与可视化工具。我们通过系统性研究比较了各数据集的标注统计特性，评估了其位姿与校准精度。进一步，我们展示了123D支持的两类应用：跨数据集三维目标检测迁移与强化学习规划，并为未来研究方向提出建议。代码与文档详见https://github.com/kesai-labs/py123d。

Authors: Daniel Dauner, Valentin Charraut, Bastian Berle, Tianyu Li, Long Nguyen, Jiabao Wang, Changhui Jing, Maximilian Igl, Holger Caesar, Boris Ivanovic, Yiyi Liao, Andreas Geiger, Kashyap Chitta

TAVIS: A Benchmark for Egocentric Active Vision and Anticipatory Gaze in Imitation Learning HumanoidEmbodied

active vision imitation learning benchmark anticipatory gaze humanoid

简要说明：提出了TAVIS，一个用于模仿学习中自我中心主动视觉和预期性注视的基准，包含任务套件、评估原语和在仿人上半身机器人上的基线实验。

TLDR: Introduces TAVIS, a benchmark for egocentric active vision and anticipatory gaze in imitation learning, with task suites, evaluation primitives, and baseline experiments on humanoid torsos.

Abstract: Active vision -- where a policy controls its own gaze during manipulation -- has emerged as a key capability for imitation learning, with multiple independent systems demonstrating its benefits in the past year. Yet there is no shared benchmark to compare approaches or quantify what active vision contributes, on which task types, and under what conditions. We introduce TAVIS, evaluation infrastructure for active-vision imitation learning, with two complementary task suites -- TAVIS-Head (5 tasks, global search via pan/tilt necks) and TAVIS-Hands (3 tasks, local occlusion via wrist cameras) -- on two humanoid torso embodiments (GR1T2, Reachy2), built on IsaacLab. TAVIS provides three evaluation primitives: a paired headcam-vs-fixedcam protocol on identical demonstrations; GALT (Gaze-Action Lead Time), a novel metric grounded in cognitive science and HRI that quantifies anticipatory gaze in learned policies; and procedural ID/OOD splits. Baseline experiments with Diffusion Policy and $π_0$ reveal that (i) active-vision generally helps, but benefits are task-conditional rather than uniform; (ii) multi-task policies degrade sharply under controlled distribution shifts on both suites; and (iii) imitation alone yields anticipatory gaze, with median lead times comparable to the human teleoperator reference. Code, evaluation scripts, demonstrations (LeRobot v3.0; ~2200 episodes) and trained baselines are released at https://github.com/spiglerg/tavis and https://huggingface.co/tavis-benchmark.

摘要（中文）：主动视觉——即策略在操控过程中自主控制其视线方向——已成为模仿学习的一项关键能力，过去一年中多个独立系统已证明其优势。然而，目前缺乏统一的基准来比较不同方法，或量化主动视觉在何种任务类型、何种条件下产生何种贡献。本文提出TAVIS——面向主动视觉模仿学习的评估框架，包含两套互补任务集：TAVIS-Head（5项任务，通过云台颈部实现全局搜索）和TAVIS-Hands（3项任务，通过腕部相机应对局部遮挡），基于IsaacLab平台在两个人形躯干实体（GR1T2、Reachy2）上构建。TAVIS提供三项评估核心模块：基于相同演示数据的头戴相机与固定相机对比协议；GALT（凝视-动作引导时间）——一种基于认知科学与人机交互的新颖指标，用于量化学习策略中的预期性凝视；以及程序化的同分布/分布外数据划分。通过Diffusion Policy和$π_0$策略的基线实验表明：（i）主动视觉通常有效，但其效益具有任务条件依赖性而非普遍适用；（ii）多任务策略在两套任务集的受控分布偏移下性能急剧下降；（iii）仅通过模仿学习即可产生预期性凝视，其中位引导时间与人类远程操作者参考值相当。代码、评估脚本、演示数据（LeRobot v3.0；约2200条轨迹）及训练基线已发布于https://github.com/spiglerg/tavis 与 https://huggingface.co/tavis-benchmark。

Authors: Giacomo Spigler

NoiseGate: Learning Per-Latent Timestep Schedules as Information Gating in World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models per-latent timestep information-gating Mixture-of-Transformers robotic manipulation

简要说明：NoiseGate 将世界动作模型中的逐潜在时间步调度作为信息门控进行学习，以提升机器人操纵任务中联合视频-动作模型的动作生成性能。

TLDR: NoiseGate learns per-latent timestep schedules as information gating in World Action Models, improving action generation in joint video–action models for robotic manipulation.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) are an emerging family of policies that tie robot action generation to future-observation modeling. In this work, we focus on the joint video--action modeling paradigm, where actions and imagined future observations are co-generated along a shared denoising or flow trajectory, so that perception, prediction, and control are coupled within one generative process. Existing WAMs typically realize this paradigm with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT), where video and action tokens interact through shared self-attention. This architecture can in principle assign a separate timestep $t_f$ to each predicted latent frame, yet current systems collapse this degree of freedom onto a single shared scalar $t$. Under the noise-as-masking view of Diffusion Forcing, this shared schedule imposes the unjustified prior that every predicted latent is equally reliable for action generation. We instead view the per-latent schedule as a \emph{learnable information-gating policy}: by changing a latent frame's noise level, the policy modulates the reliability of its Key/Value contribution to the action tokens. We propose \textbf{NoiseGate}, which combines independent per-latent timestep sampling during backbone training, a lightweight Gating Policy Network that emits per-latent time increments during denoising, and task-reward optimization that trains the schedule policy without hand-crafted shape priors. Built on a joint video--action MoT backbone, NoiseGate delivers consistent gains on diverse RoboTwin random-scene manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）是一类新兴的策略框架，它将机器人动作生成与未来观测建模相结合。本研究聚焦于联合视频-动作建模范式，其中动作与预测的未来观测沿着共享的去噪或流轨迹协同生成，从而将感知、预测与控制融合在一个统一的生成过程中。现有的WAMs通常通过混合变换器（MoT）实现这一范式，视频和动作标记通过共享的自注意力机制进行交互。该架构在理论上可为每个预测的潜在帧分配独立的时步$t_f$，但现有系统却将此自由度压缩为单一的共享标量$t$。在"扩散强迫即掩码"的视角下，这种共享调度强加了一个未经验证的先验假设：每个预测的潜在帧对动作生成具有同等可靠性。我们转而将逐潜在帧的调度视为一种可学习的信息门控策略：通过调整潜在帧的噪声水平，该策略可调控其对动作标记的键值贡献的可靠性。我们提出\textbf{NoiseGate}方法，该方法结合了骨干网络训练中独立的逐潜在帧时步采样、在去噪过程中输出逐潜在帧时间增量的轻量级门控策略网络，以及无需人工设计形状先验即可训练调度策略的任务奖励优化。基于联合视频-动作MoT骨干网络构建的NoiseGate，在多样化的RoboTwin随机场景操作任务中实现了持续的性能提升。

Authors: Wen Huang, Haoran Sun, Yongjian Guo, Yunxuan Ma, Haoran Li, Jing Long, Zhouying Mo, Zhong Guan, Yucheng Guo, Shuai Di, Junwu Xiong

MemCompiler: Compile, Don't Inject -- State-Conditioned Memory for Embodied Agents VLN

embodied agents memory system state-conditioned memory compilation soft-mem channel

简要说明：本文提出MemCompiler，一种用于具身智能体的状态条件记忆编译方法，它动态选择并编译相关记忆为可执行指导，相比静态注入方法提升了性能和效率。

TLDR: The paper proposes MemCompiler, a state-conditioned memory compilation approach for embodied agents that dynamically selects and compiles relevant memory into executable guidance, improving performance and efficiency over static injection methods.

Abstract: Existing memory systems for embodied agents typically inject retrieved memory as static context at episode start, a paradigm we term Ahead-of-time Monolithic Memory Injection (AMMI). However, this static design quickly becomes misaligned with the agent's evolving state and may degrade lightweight executors below the no-memory baseline. To address this, we propose MemCompiler, which reframes memory utilization as State-Conditioned Memory Compilation. A learned Memory Compiler reads a structured Brief State capturing the agent's current execution state and dynamically selects and compiles only relevant memory into executable guidance. This guidance is delivered through a text channel and a latent Soft-Mem channel that preserves perceptual information not expressible in text. Across Alf World, EmbodiedBench, and ScienceWorld, MemCompiler consistently improves over no-memory across open-source backbones (up to +129%), matches or approaches frontier closed-source systems, and reduces per-step latency by 60%, demonstrating that state-aware memory compilation improves both effectiveness and efficiency.

摘要（中文）：现有的具身智能体记忆系统通常在任务起始阶段将检索到的记忆作为静态上下文注入，这一范式被称为提前式整体记忆注入（AMMI）。然而，这种静态设计会快速与智能体动态演变的状态失配，并可能导致轻量化执行器的性能退化至低于无记忆基线的水平。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MemCompiler，其将记忆利用重新定义为状态条件化记忆编译。通过学习式记忆编译器读取捕捉智能体当前执行状态的结构化简要状态，动态选择并编译仅相关的记忆为可执行指导。该指导通过文本通道与潜在软记忆通道传递，后者保留了文本无法表达的感知信息。在Alf World、EmbodiedBench和ScienceWorld三个测试平台中，MemCompiler在开源骨干模型上相较于无记忆基线的性能提升高达129%，达到或逼近前沿闭源系统水平，同时将单步延迟降低60%，证明了状态感知记忆编译在效能与效率上的双重优势。

Authors: Xin Ding, Xinrui Wang, Yifan Yang, Hao Wu, Shiqi Jiang, Qianxi Zhang, Liang Mi, Hanxin Zhu, Kun Li, Yunxin Liu, Zhibo Chen, Ting Cao

How to utilize failure demo data?: Effective data selection for imitation learning using distribution differences in attention mechanism Manipulation

imitation learning failure data attention mechanism latent representations data selection

简要说明：该论文提出了一种模仿学习方法，通过学习和失败差异的隐表示并将其整合到注意力机制中，利用失败演示数据来提升动作稳定性和任务成功率。

TLDR: The paper proposes a method for imitation learning that utilizes failure demonstrations by learning latent representations of success-failure discrepancies and incorporating them into the attention mechanism, improving action stability and task success rates.

Abstract: Imitation learning for robotic tasks has relied primarily on policies trained only on successful demonstrations, although failures are unavoidable during human data collection. Many existing approaches for exploiting failure data require additional data processing or iterative policy updates through autonomous rollouts, making it difficult to directly and stably utilize failure data accumulated during data collection. In this work, we propose a method that learns latent representations of success-failure discrepancies and incorporates them into the attention mechanism. During inference, an appropriate latent mode is selected from the initial observation to improve action stability. Furthermore, we introduce a post-training metric that quantifies the attention discrepancy between each failure sample and successful demonstrations to select failure data. Simulation results show that the proposed method improves task success rates when trained with failure data and that the proposed metric identifies failure samples that are beneficial for learning when combined with successful demonstrations. These results suggest that the proposed method can support more efficient use of collected demonstrations in robotic data collection pipelines.

摘要（中文）：机器人任务的模仿学习主要依赖于仅在成功演示上训练的策略，尽管在人类数据收集过程中失败是不可避免的。许多现有利用失败数据的方法需要额外的数据处理或通过自主执行进行迭代策略更新，这导致难以直接且稳定地利用数据收集中积累的失败数据。本研究提出一种方法，通过学习成功与失败差异的潜在表示，并将其融入注意力机制中。在推理过程中，从初始观察中选择适当的潜在模式以提高动作稳定性。此外，我们引入一种训练后评估指标，用于量化每个失败样本与成功演示之间的注意力差异，从而筛选出对学习有益的失败数据。仿真结果表明，当使用失败数据训练时，所提方法能够提高任务成功率，且该指标能够结合成功演示筛选出对学习有利的失败样本。这些结果说明，所提方法能够支持在机器人数据收集流程中更有效地利用已收集的演示数据。

Authors: Kana Miyamoto, Kanata Suzuki, Tetsuya Ogata

Is the Future Compatible? Diagnosing Dynamic Consistency in World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models action-state consistency robotic rollouts test-time selection value-free planning

简要说明：本文提出动作-状态一致性作为评估世界动作模型可靠性的诊断工具，并引入一种无需价值的共识策略进行测试时选择，在机器人操作基准上提高了任务成功率，且无需额外训练。

TLDR: This paper introduces action-state consistency as a diagnostic tool for World Action Models (WAMs) reliability and proposes a value-free consensus strategy for test-time rollout selection, improving task success rates on robotic manipulation benchmarks without additional training.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) enable decision-making through imagined rollouts by predicting future observations and actions. However, the reliability of these imagined futures remains under-examined: is a generated future merely visually plausible, or is it dynamically compatible with the action sequence it claims to model? In this work, we identify action-state consistency, the alignment between predicted actions and induced state transitions, as a missing reliability axis for WAMs. Through a systematic study across representative joint-prediction and inverse-dynamics models, we find that action-state consistency systematically separates successful and failed rollouts across many tasks and follows similar success-failure trends as learned value estimates. These results suggest that consistency captures decision-relevant structure beyond visual realism. We further identify background collapse as an important boundary condition, where low-dynamics failed trajectories can become deceptively consistent because static futures are easier to predict. Building on these findings, we introduce a value-free consensus strategy for test-time selection, which ranks candidate rollouts by agreement among predicted futures. This strategy improves success rates on RoboCasa and RoboTwin 2.0 without additional training or reward modeling. Taken together, our findings establish action-state consistency as both a diagnostic tool for evaluating WAM reliability and a practical signal for value-free planning.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAM）通过预测未来观测与行动，借助想象推演实现决策。然而，这些想象未来的可靠性仍待检验：生成的未来仅仅是视觉上合理，还是与其试图模拟的行动序列在动态层面兼容？本研究提出行动-状态一致性——即预测行动与诱发状态转移之间的对齐关系——作为世界行动模型缺失的可靠性维度。通过对代表性联合预测模型与逆动力学模型的系统研究，我们发现行动-状态一致性在多任务场景中能系统地区分成功与失败的推演轨迹，其成功-失败趋势与学习到的价值估计具有相似规律。这些结果表明，一致性捕捉到的决策相关结构超越了视觉真实性的范畴。我们进一步发现背景坍缩现象构成重要边界条件：当动态性较低时，失败的轨迹可能因静态未来更易预测而产生欺骗性一致。基于这些发现，我们提出一种免价值共识策略用于测试时选择，通过预测未来之间的吻合度对候选推演进行排序。该策略在RoboCasa和RoboTwin 2.0环境中无需额外训练或奖励建模即可提升任务成功率。综合而言，本研究确立了行动-状态一致性既可作为评估世界行动模型可靠性的诊断工具，也可成为免价值规划实践中的有效信号。

Authors: Bo-Kai Ruan, Teng-Fang Hsiao, Ling Lo, Hong-Han Shuai

Escaping the Diversity Trap in Robotic Manipulation via Anchor-Centric Adaptation Manipulation

VLA Robotic Manipulation Adaptation Data Collection Real-Robot

简要说明：该论文提出了锚点中心自适应方法，一种用于VLA策略在真实世界部署的两阶段数据收集与适应框架，解决了覆盖范围与数据密度的权衡问题，以在有限数据预算下提升任务可靠性。

TLDR: The paper proposes Anchor-Centric Adaptation, a two-stage data collection and adaptation framework for real-world deployment of VLA policies, which addresses the coverage-density trade-off to improve reliability under a limited data budget.

Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer broad general capabilities, deploying them on specific hardware requires real-world adaptation to bridge the embodiment gap. Since robot demonstrations are costly, this adaptation must often occur under a strict data budget. In this work, we identify a critical diversity trap: the standard heuristic of "maximizing coverage" by collecting diverse, single-shot demonstrations can be self-defeating due to non-vanishing estimation noise. We formalize this phenomenon as a Coverage--Density Trade-off. By decomposing the policy error into estimation (density) and extrapolation (coverage) terms, we characterize an interior optimal allocation of unique conditions for a fixed budget. Guided by this analysis, we propose Anchor-Centric Adaptation (ACA), a two-stage framework that first stabilizes a policy skeleton through repeated demonstrations at core anchors, then selectively expands coverage to high-risk boundaries via teacher-forced error mining and constrained residual updates. Real-robot experiments validate our trade-off framework and demonstrate that ACA significantly improves task reliability and success rates over standard diverse sampling strategies under the same budget.

摘要（中文）：尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型具备广泛通用能力，但其在特定硬件上的部署仍需通过现实世界适应性调整来弥合具身智能差距。由于机器人演示数据获取成本高昂，此类适配通常必须在严格的数据预算下进行。本研究揭示了一个关键性的多样性陷阱：标准启发式方法通过收集多样化的单次演示来"最大化覆盖范围"，却可能因非零估计噪声而适得其反。我们将此现象形式化为覆盖度与密度权衡问题。通过将策略误差分解为估计（密度）项和外推（覆盖）项，我们刻画了固定预算下独特场景数量的最优分配方式。基于此分析，我们提出锚点中心化适配框架（ACA）：该两阶段方法首先通过在核心锚点进行重复演示以稳定策略骨架，随后通过教师强制误差挖掘和约束残差更新，选择性地将覆盖范围扩展至高风险边界。真实机器人实验验证了我们的权衡框架，并证明在相同预算下，ACA相比标准多样化采样策略能显著提升任务可靠性与成功率。

Authors: Yanzhe Chen, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Qi Lv, Yiqi Lin, Zechen Bai, Chen Gao, Mike Zheng Shou

Learning Visual Feature-Based World Models via Residual Latent Action WorldModel

residual latent action world model flow matching robot learning offline videos

简要说明：该论文提出RLA-WM，一种通过残差潜在动作和流匹配来预测未来视觉特征的世界模型，并展示了其机器人学习应用，包括从无动作演示视频中学习的世界动作模型，以及一个完全在离线视频学习的世界模型内部训练且无需在线交互的视觉RL框架。

TLDR: The paper proposes RLA-WM, a world model that predicts future visual features via residual latent action and flow matching, and demonstrates robot learning applications including a world action model from actionless videos and a visual RL framework trained entirely inside the world model using offline videos.

Abstract: World models predict future transitions from observations and actions. Existing works predominantly focus on image generation only. Visual feature-based world models, on the other hand, predict future visual features instead of raw video pixels, offering a promising alternative that is more efficient and less prone to hallucination. However, current feature-based approaches rely on direct regression, which leads to blurry or collapsed predictions in complex interactions, while generative modeling in high-dimensional feature spaces still remains challenging. In this work, we discover that a new type of latent action representation, which we refer to as *Residual Latent Action* (RLA), can be easily learned from DINO residuals. We also show that RLA is predictive, generalizable, and encodes temporal progression. Building on RLA, we propose *RLA World Model* (RLA-WM), which predicts RLA values via flow matching. RLA-WM outperforms both state-of-the-art feature-based and video-diffusion world models on simulation and real-world datasets, while being orders of magnitude faster than video diffusion. Furthermore, we develop two robot learning techniques that use RLA-WM to improve policy learning. The first one is a minimalist world action model with RLA that learns from actionless demonstration videos. The second one is the first visual RL framework trained entirely inside a world model learned from offline videos only, using a video-aligned reward and no online interactions or handcrafted rewards. Project page: https://mlzxy.github.io/rla-wm

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过观察和行动预测未来的状态转移。现有研究主要集中于图像生成。相比之下，基于视觉特征的世界模型不直接预测原始视频像素，而是预测未来的视觉特征，这提供了一种更高效且不易产生幻觉的替代方案。然而，当前基于特征的方法依赖于直接回归，导致在复杂交互中预测结果模糊或坍缩，而高维特征空间中的生成建模仍具挑战性。在本研究中，我们发现一种新型的潜在行动表示——我们称之为*残差潜在行动*（RLA），能够从DINO残差中轻松学习。我们还证明了RLA具有可预测性、泛化性，并能编码时间进程。基于RLA，我们提出*RLA世界模型*（RLA-WM），通过流匹配方法预测RLA值。RLA-WM在仿真和真实数据集上均优于当前最先进的基于特征模型和视频扩散世界模型，且计算速度比视频扩散快数个数量级。此外，我们开发了两种利用RLA-WM改进策略学习的机器人学习技术：第一种是结合RLA的极简世界行动模型，可从无行动示范视频中学习；第二种是首个完全在仅通过离线视频学习的世界模型内训练的视觉强化学习框架，使用视频对齐的奖励函数，无需在线交互或人工设计奖励。项目页面：https://mlzxy.github.io/rla-wm

Authors: Xinyu Zhang, Zhengtong Xu, Yutian Tao, Yeping Wang, Yu She, Abdeslam Boularias

One Token Per Frame: Reconsidering Visual Bandwidth in World Models for VLA Policy VLA

per-frame visual compression single semantic token Adaptive Attention Pooling flow-matching objective world-model-augmented VLA

简要说明：OneWM-VLA 提出将每帧视觉压缩为单一令牌，并采用统一的流匹配目标来增强世界模型与VLA，在模拟和真实机器人基准上提升了长时域任务的性能。

TLDR: OneWM-VLA introduces per-frame visual compression to a single token and a unified flow-matching objective for world-model-augmented VLAs, improving long-horizon task performance across simulated and real robot benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on auxiliary world modules to plan over long horizons, yet how such modules should be parameterized on top of a pretrained VLA remains an open design question. Existing world-model-augmented VLAs typically pass the per-frame visual stream into the world module at high visual bandwidth and treat its rollout as a side product of action prediction; under a constrained adaptation budget on a frozen backbone, this leaves both the per-frame representation and the latent action coupling under-examined. We introduce OneWM-VLA, which compresses each view into a single semantic token per frame through an Adaptive Attention Pooling, and produces the resulting latent stream and the action trajectory under a single flow-matching objective rather than connecting them through a separate decoder. Empirically, we find that per-frame visual bandwidth can be reduced to a single token without compromising long-horizon performance under our setup. Trained with 14.71M LoRA parameters on a $π_0$ (2B) backbone, OneWM-VLA improves the average success rate from 47.9% to 61.3% on MetaWorld~MT50, reaches 95.6% on LIBERO-Long (vs.85.2% for $π_0$), and reaches 60.0% on the long-horizon deformable task Fold Cloth on a real Piper arm (vs.20.0% for $π_0$).

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型日益依赖辅助世界模块进行长时程规划，但此类模块应如何在预训练的VLA模型上进行参数化仍是一个开放的设计问题。现有基于世界模块增强的VLA通常将每帧视觉流以高带宽输入世界模块，并将其推演结果视为动作预测的副产品；在冻结主干网络并限制适应预算的条件下，这种设计导致对每帧表征与潜在动作耦合关系的探究不足。我们提出OneWM-VLA模型，通过自适应注意力池化将每帧视图压缩为单个语义标记，并在单一流匹配目标下生成潜在流与动作轨迹，而非通过独立解码器进行连接。实验表明，在我们的框架下，每帧视觉带宽可压缩至单个标记而不会影响长时程任务性能。在2B参数的π₀主干网络上使用1471万LoRA参数进行训练后，OneWM-VLA在MetaWorld MT50上的平均成功率从47.9%提升至61.3%，在LIBERO-Long任务上达到95.6%（π₀为85.2%），并在真实Piper机械臂上完成长时程变形任务Fold Cloth时达到60.0%成功率（π₀为20.0%）。

Authors: Zuojin Tang, Shengchao Yuan, Xiaoxin Bai, Zhiyuan Jin, De Ma, Gang Pan, Bin Liu

Predictive but Not Plannable: RC-aux for Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models planning reachability auxiliary objective goal-conditioned control

简要说明：提出RC-aux，一种用于隐世界模型的辅助目标，通过使隐空间与有限动作预算下的可达性对齐来改进规划，从而实现更有效的目标导向搜索。

TLDR: Proposes RC-aux, an auxiliary objective for latent world models to improve planning by aligning the latent space with reachability under a finite action budget, enabling more effective goal-directed search.

Abstract: A latent world model may achieve accurate short-horizon prediction while still inducing a latent space that is poorly aligned with planning. A key issue is spatiotemporal mismatch: these models are often trained with local predictive supervision, but deployed for long-horizon goal-directed search in latent spaces where Euclidean distance may not reflect what is reachable within a finite action budget. We present the Reachability-Correction auxiliary objective (RC-aux), a lightweight correction for this mismatch in reconstruction-free latent world models. RC-aux keeps the world-model backbone unchanged and adds planning-aligned supervision along two axes. Along the time axis, multi-horizon open-loop prediction trains the model beyond one-step consistency. Along the space axis, budget-conditioned reachability supervision, together with temporal hard negatives, encourages the latent space to distinguish states that are eventually reachable from those reachable within the current planning horizon. At test time, the learned reachability signal can also be used by a reachability-aware planner to favor trajectories that are both goal-directed and attainable under the available budget. We instantiate RC-aux on LeWorldModel and evaluate it under both continuation-training and matched-from-scratch settings. Across goal-conditioned pixel-control tasks and a LIBERO-Goal extension, RC-aux improves LeWM-style planning with modest additional cost. These results suggest that planning with latent world models depends not only on predictive accuracy, but also on whether the learned representation encodes the temporal and geometric structure required by downstream search. The code is available at https://github.com/Guang000/RC-aux.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型可能在实现准确短期预测的同时，其学习到的潜在空间仍与规划任务失配。核心问题在于时空错位：这类模型通常通过局部预测监督进行训练，但在实际部署时却需要在潜在空间中进行长时程目标导向搜索，而该空间中的欧氏距离可能无法反映在有限动作预算下可达的实际状态。本文提出可达性校正辅助目标（RC-aux），作为一种轻量级校正方法，专门针对无需重建的潜在世界模型中的时空错位问题。RC-aux在保持世界模型主干不变的前提下，沿两个维度增加了与规划对齐的监督机制：时间维度上，通过多时程开环预测训练模型超越单步一致性约束；空间维度上，结合预算条件化可达性监督与时序硬负样本，促使潜在空间能够区分最终可达状态与当前规划时域内可达状态。在测试阶段，习得的可达性信号还可供具有可达性感知能力的规划器使用，以优先选择既符合目标导向又满足当前预算约束的轨迹。我们在LeWorldModel框架中实现RC-aux，并在持续训练与从头匹配两种设置下进行评估。在目标条件像素控制任务及LIBERO-Goal扩展任务中，RC-aux以适度增加的计算成本提升了LeWM风格规划的性能。结果表明，基于潜在世界模型的规划不仅依赖于预测精度，更取决于学习到的表征是否能够编码下游搜索所需的时间与几何结构。代码发布于https://github.com/Guang000/RC-aux。

Authors: Wenyuan Li, Guang Li, Keisuke Maeda, Takahiro Ogawa, Miki Haseyama

AGWM: Affordance-Grounded World Models for Environments with Compositional Prerequisites WorldModel

world models affordance prerequisite dependencies structure-changing events multi-step prediction

简要说明：提出AGWM，一种学习抽象可供性有向无环图的世界模型，用于跟踪动作可执行性，以降低具有组合前提条件的环境中的多步预测误差。

TLDR: Proposes AGWM, a world model that learns an abstract affordance DAG to track action executability and reduce multi-step prediction error in environments with compositional prerequisites.

Abstract: In model-based learning, the agent learns behaviors by simulating trajectories based on world model predictions. Standard world models typically learn a stationary transition function that maps states and actions to next states, when an action and an outcome frequently co-occur in training data, the model tends to internalize this correlation as a general causal rule while ignoring action preconditions. In interactive environments, however, agent actions can reshape the future affordance space. At each timestep, an action may becomes executable only after its prerequisites are met, or non-executable when they are destroyed. We term such events structure-changing events (SC events). As a result, a conventional world model often fails to determine whether a given action is executable in the current state, especially in multi-step predictions. Each imagined step is conditioned on an incorrect affordance state, and therefore the prediction error compounds over the rollout horizon. In this paper, we propose AGWM (Affordance-Grounded World Model), which learns an abstract affordance structure represented as a DAG of prerequisite dependencies to explicitly track the dynamic executability of actions. Experiments on game-based simulated environments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by achieving lower multi-step prediction error, better generalization to novel configurations, and improved interpretability.

摘要（中文）：在基于模型的学习中，智能体通过基于世界模型预测模拟轨迹来学习行为。标准世界模型通常学习一个固定的转移函数，将状态和动作映射到下一状态。当某个动作与其结果在训练数据中频繁共现时，模型倾向于将这种相关性内化为一般因果规则，而忽略动作的先决条件。然而，在交互式环境中，智能体的动作能够重塑未来的可供性空间。在每一时间步，动作可能仅在其前提条件满足后才可执行，或在前提条件被破坏后变为不可执行。我们将此类事件称为结构改变事件（SC事件）。因此，传统世界模型常无法判断给定动作在当前状态下是否可执行，尤其是在多步预测中。每个想象步骤都基于错误的可供性状态，导致预测误差在推演过程中不断累积。本文提出AGWM（可供性基础世界模型），该模型通过学习以有向无环图表示的抽象可供性结构来显式追踪动作的动态可执行性，其中图中节点表示先决依赖关系。基于游戏模拟环境的实验表明，该方法能够有效降低多步预测误差、提升对新配置的泛化能力并增强可解释性。

Authors: Qinshi Zhang, Weipeng Deng, Zhihan Jiang, Jiaming Qu, Qianren Li, Weitao Xu, Ray LC

One World, Dual Timeline: Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Scene Graph for 4D Cooperative Driving Reconstruction AutonomousDriving

4D reconstruction Gaussian Scene Graph temporal asynchrony cooperative driving dynamic agents

简要说明：针对车路协同自动驾驶数据中固有的时间异步问题，提出了解耦时空高斯场景图方法DUST，用于4D动态场景重建，消除了动态目标的鬼影伪影并取得最优性能。

TLDR: Proposes DUST, a decoupled spatio-temporal Gaussian scene graph method for 4D reconstruction from temporally asynchronous multi-view driving data, eliminating ghosting artifacts and achieving SOTA.

Abstract: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from Vehicle-to-Infrastructure Cooperative Autonomous Driving (VICAD) data is fundamentally complicated by temporal asynchrony: vehicle and infrastructure cameras operate on independent clocks, capturing the same dynamic agent such as cars and pedestrians at different physical times. Existing Gaussian Scene Graph methods implicitly assume synchronized observations and assign a single pose per agent per frame, which is an assumption that breaks in cooperative settings, where the resulting gradient conflicts cause severe ghosting on dynamic agents. We identify this as a representation-level failure, not an optimization artifact: we prove that any single-timeline formulation incurs an irreducible photometric loss scaling quadratically with agent velocity and cross-source time offset. To resolve this, we propose Dust (DecoUpled Spatio-Temporal) Gaussian Scene Graph for 4D Cooperative Driving Reconstruction. DUST Gaussian Scene Graph shares a canonical Gaussian set per agent for appearance consistency, while maintaining decouple pose trajectories aligned to each source's true capture timestamps. We prove that this decoupling enables the pose-gradient kernel block-diagonal, eliminating cross-source interference entirely. To make Dust practical, we further introduce a static anchor-based pose correction pipeline that corrects spatio misalignment between vehicle and infrastructure annotations, and a pose-regularized joint optimization scheme that prevents trajectory jitter and drift during early training. On 26 sequences from V2X-Seq, DUST achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving dynamic-area PSNR by 3.2 dB over the strongest baseline and reducing Fréchet Video Distance by 37.7%, with keeping robustness under larger temporal asynchrony. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DUST-6A55.

摘要（中文）：基于车路协同自动驾驶（VICAD）数据重建动态场景，从根本上受到时间异步性的复杂影响：车辆与路侧基础设施摄像头基于独立时钟运行，在不同物理时刻捕捉同一动态主体（如车辆和行人）。现有高斯场景图方法隐含假设观测数据同步，并假设每个主体在每帧中仅对应单一姿态，这一假设在协同场景中失效，导致梯度冲突引发动态主体产生严重伪影。我们认为这是表征层面的缺陷而非优化伪影：证明任何基于单时间线的建模都会产生不可消除的光度损失，其损失与主体速度及跨数据源时间偏差呈二次增长。为解决此问题，我们提出面向四维协同驾驶重建的Dust（解耦时空）高斯场景图。该方法为每个主体共享规范化的高斯集合以保持外观一致性，同时维护解耦的姿态轨迹，使其分别与各数据源的真实采集时间戳对齐。我们证明这种解耦机制使姿态梯度核矩阵呈现块对角结构，从而完全消除跨数据源干扰。为使Dust具备实用性，我们进一步提出基于静态锚点的姿态校正流程，以修正车辆与基础设施标注间的空间错位，以及姿态正则化联合优化方案，防止训练早期出现轨迹抖动与漂移。在V2X-Seq数据集26个序列上的实验表明，DUST取得了最先进的性能表现：动态区域峰值信噪比相较于最强基线提升3.2 dB，弗雷歇视频距离降低37.7%，并在更大时间异步性条件下保持鲁棒性。代码已发布于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DUST-6A55。

Authors: Yulong Chen, Xiaoyun Dong, Haoyu Zhang, Zongxian Yang, Lewei Xie, Xinke Li, Yifan Zhang, Kai Wang, Jianping Wang

GEM: Generating LiDAR World Model via Deformable Mamba AutonomousDriving

LiDAR world model deformable Mamba dynamic-static separation generative model autonomous driving

简要说明：提出GEM，一种使用可变形Mamba架构的生成式LiDAR世界模型，解决点云无序和动静分离问题，推进自动驾驶世界模型发展。

TLDR: Proposes GEM, a generative LiDAR world model using deformable Mamba architecture to address the disorder of point clouds and dynamic-static separation, advancing autonomous driving world models.

Abstract: World models, which simulate environmental dynamics and generate sensor observations, are gaining increasing attention in autonomous driving. However, progress in LiDAR-based world models has lagged behind those built on camera videos or occupancy data, primarily due to two core challenges: the inherent disorder of LiDAR point clouds and the difficulty of distinguishing dynamic objects from static structures. To address these issues, we propose GEM: a Generative LiDAR world model that leverages deformable mamba architecture, significantly improving fidelity and imaginative capability. Specifically, leveraging the structural similarity between sequential laser scanning and Mamba's processing mechanism, we first tokenize LiDAR sweeps into compact representations via a custom LiDAR scene tokenizer. After unsupervised disentanglement of tokenized features via a dynamic-static separator, a tri-path deformable Mamba is introduced to perform selective scanning and adaptive gating fusion over the disentangled features, leading to enhanced spatial-temporal understanding of the world evolution. Optionally, a planner and a BEV layout controller can be integrated to explore the model's capability for autonomous rollout and its potential to generate ``what-if" scenarios. Extensive experiments show that GEM achieves state-of-the-art performances across diverse benchmarks and evaluation settings, demonstrating its superiority and effectiveness. Project page: https://github.com/wuyang98/GEM.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 世界模型通过模拟环境动态并生成传感器观测数据，在自动驾驶领域日益受到关注。然而，基于激光雷达的世界模型发展滞后于基于相机视频或占据栅格数据的模型，这主要源于两大核心挑战：激光雷达点云固有的无序性以及动态物体与静态结构难以区分的问题。为解决这些难题，我们提出了GEM：一种利用可变形Mamba架构的生成式激光雷达世界模型，显著提升了模拟的逼真度与想象能力。具体而言，借助序列化激光扫描与Mamba处理机制之间的结构相似性，我们首先通过定制的激光雷达场景标记器将激光雷达扫描数据编码为紧凑的表示形式。在通过动态-静态分离器对标记化特征进行无监督解耦后，引入三路径可变形Mamba结构，对解耦后的特征执行选择性扫描与自适应门控融合，从而增强对世界演变的时空理解能力。该模型可选择性集成规划器与鸟瞰图布局控制器，以探索其自主推演能力及生成“假设”场景的潜力。大量实验表明，GEM在多种基准测试与评估设置中均达到最先进的性能水平，证明了其优越性与有效性。项目页面：https://github.com/wuyang98/GEM。

Authors: Yang Wu, Zhaojiang Liu, Qiang Meng, Youquan Liu, Renliang Weng, Jianjun Qian, Jian Yang, Jin Xie

See Tomorrow, Act Today: Foresight-Driven Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

world model foresight-driven planning anticipatory decision-making end-to-end autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出ForeSight，一个以世界模型为核心的自动驾驶规划框架，将规划重新定义为预期决策：首先生成合理的未来视觉世界，然后基于这些想象出的未来规划行动。

TLDR: This paper proposes ForeSight, a foundation world model centric planning framework for autonomous driving that reframes planning as anticipatory decision-making by first generating plausible future visual worlds and then planning actions conditioned on these imagined futures.

Abstract: Current end-to-end autonomous driving planners are fundamentally reactive: they condition on historical and present observations to predict future actions. We argue that autonomous agents should instead imagine future scenes before deciding, just as human drivers mentally simulate ``what will happen next" before acting. We introduce ForeSight, a foundation world model centric planning framework that reframes autonomous driving as anticipatory decision-making. Rather than treating world models as auxiliary components, ForeSight makes future scene imagination the primary driver of action prediction. Our approach operates in two stages: (1) generating plausible future visual worlds via a pretrained world model, and (2) planning actions conditioned on these imagined futures. This paradigm shift from ``what should I do now?" to ``what will happen, and how should I respond?" enables genuinely anticipatory rather than reactive planning. By grounding decisions in anticipated contexts rather than present observations alone, ForeSight navigates dynamic, interactive scenarios more effectively. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes demonstrate that explicit future imagination significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art alternatives, validating our foresight-driven approach.

摘要（中文）：当前的端到端自动驾驶规划器本质上是反应式的：它们基于历史和当前观测来预测未来行为。我们主张自动驾驶智能体应在决策前预想未来场景，正如人类驾驶员在行动前会进行心理模拟"接下来会发生什么"。为此，我们提出ForeSight——一个以世界基模型为核心的规划框架，将自动驾驶重新定义为预见性决策过程。ForeSight不仅将世界模型作为辅助工具，更将未来场景想象作为行动预测的核心驱动力。我们的方法包含两个阶段：(1)通过预训练的世界模型生成合理的未来视觉场景，(2)基于这些想象场景进行行为规划。这种从"我现在该做什么？"到"将会发生什么？我该如何应对？"的范式转变，实现了真正的预见性规划而非被动反应。通过将决策建立在对预期情境的考量而非单纯当前观测的基础上，ForeSight能够更有效地应对动态交互场景。在NAVSIM和nuScenes数据集上的大量实验表明，显式的未来场景想象显著超越现有最优方法，验证了我们预见性驱动框架的有效性。

Active Embodiment Identification with Reinforcement Learning for Legged Robots Locomotion

embodiment identification reinforcement learning legged robots active learning parameter inference

简要说明：提出一种用于腿式机器人的主动本体识别方法，通过强化学习在模拟环境中学习信息寻求行为并预测本体参数。

TLDR: Proposes an active embodiment identification method for legged robots using reinforcement learning to learn information-seeking behavior and predict embodiment parameters through interaction in simulation.

Abstract: We present an active embodiment identification method for legged robots that jointly learns information-seeking behavior and explicit embodiment prediction. Using a history-augmented URMA architecture, the method infers joint-level and global embodiment parameters through interaction with the environment in simulation across different morphologies.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种用于腿式机器人的主动本体识别方法，该方法能够同时学习信息探索行为与显式本体预测。通过采用历史增强的通用机器人模型架构，该方法能在不同形态的仿真环境中，通过与环境的交互来推断关节级和全局本体参数。

Authors: Nico Bohlinger, Jan Peters

Evaluation of an Actuated Spine in Agile Quadruped Locomotion Locomotion

Actuated spine Quadruped locomotion Agile locomotion Simulation MuJoCo

简要说明：本文通过仿真经验性地评估了在四足机器人中使用一自由度驱动脊柱对提升高速奔跑、攀爬、越障等灵巧运动能力的好处。

TLDR: This paper empirically evaluates the benefits of an actuated 1-DOF spine for improving agile locomotion capabilities like running, climbing, and hurdling in a quadruped robot using simulation.

Abstract: The spine plays a crucial role in the dynamic locomotion of quadrupedal animals, improving the stability, speed, and efficiency of their gait, especially for fast-paced and highly agile movements. Therefore, the spine is also a promising and natural way to extend the capabilities of quadruped robots. This paper empirically investigates the benefits of an actuated spine for learning agile quadruped locomotion. We evaluate whether the use of the spine brings benefits in terms of high-speed running, climbing stairs, climbing high-angle slopes, hurdling, and crawling scenarios. We conducted an empirical study in MuJoCo simulation using the Silver Badger robot from MAB Robotics with an actuated 1-DOF spine in the sagittal plane. The obtained results show that the use of the spine provides the robot with increased agility and allows it to overcome higher stairs, steeper slopes, higher obstacles, and smaller passages.

摘要（中文）：脊柱在四足动物的动态运动中扮演着至关重要的角色，能够提升其步态的稳定性、速度与效率，尤其在高速与高敏捷性运动中表现显著。因此，将脊柱应用于四足机器人，也是拓展其能力的一种具有潜力且自然的方式。本文通过实验研究驱动式脊柱对学习敏捷四足运动的作用。我们评估了脊柱的使用是否在高速奔跑、爬楼梯、攀爬高角度斜坡、跨栏及匍匐爬行等场景中带来优势。我们在MuJoCo仿真环境中使用MAB Robotics公司的Silver Badger机器人进行了实证研究，该机器人在矢状面配置了一个单自由度驱动式脊柱。实验结果表明，脊柱的使用显著提升了机器人的敏捷性，使其能够跨越更高的台阶、攀爬更陡的斜坡、翻越更高的障碍物并通过更狭窄的通道。

Authors: Nico Bohlinger, Piotr Kicki, Davide Tateo, Krzysztof Walas, Jan Peters

AERO-VIS: Asynchronous Event-based Real-time Onboard Visual-Inertial SLAM Perception3D

event-based SLAM visual-inertial odometry onboard compute closed-loop UAV control asynchronous processing

简要说明：AERO-VIS是一个具有异步处理流水线和数据驱动关键点检测器的立体事件-惯性SLAM系统，实现了实时、机载、闭环的无人机控制。

TLDR: AERO-VIS is a stereo event-inertial SLAM system with an asynchronous processing pipeline and a data-driven keypoint detector, enabling real-time, onboard, closed-loop UAV control.

Abstract: The robustness of event cameras to high dynamic range and motion blur holds the potential to improve visual odometry systems in challenging environments. Although their high temporal resolution does not require synchronous processing, most event-based odometry methods still run at fixed rates, which simplifies system design but restricts latency and throughput. In this work, we present AERO-VIS, a stereo event-inertial SLAM system with an integrated, data-driven, robust, and performance-optimized keypoint detector. By processing the event stream asynchronously, the system dynamically adapts to downstream runtime demands, ensuring low-latency and real-time performance. When deploying AERO-VIS on a UAV, we achieve unprecedented accuracy in onboard event-based SLAM. These unique characteristics enable us to present the first purely event-based inertial SLAM system that demonstrates closed-loop UAV control and large-scale state estimation while relying solely on onboard compute. A video of the experiments and the source code are available at ethz-mrl.github.io/AERO-VIS.

摘要（中文）：事件相机在高动态范围与运动模糊下的鲁棒性，有望在挑战性环境中提升视觉里程计系统的性能。尽管其高时间分辨率无需同步处理，但大多数基于事件的里程计方法仍以固定速率运行，这虽简化了系统设计，却限制了延迟与吞吐量。本研究提出AERO-VIS——一种集成了数据驱动、鲁棒且性能优化的关键点检测器的立体事件-惯性SLAM系统。通过异步处理事件流，系统能够动态适应下游运行时的需求，确保低延迟与实时性能。将AERO-VIS部署于无人机上时，我们在基于机载事件SLAM中实现了前所未有的精度。这些独特特性使我们首次实现了纯基于事件的惯性SLAM系统，该系统在仅依赖机载计算的前提下，完成了闭环无人机控制与大规模状态估计。实验视频与源代码详见ethz-mrl.github.io/AERO-VIS。

Authors: Yannick Burkhardt, Sebastián Barbas Laina, Simon Boche, Leonard Freißmuth, Stefan Leutenegger

Offline-Online Hierarchical 3D Global Relocalization With Synthetic LiDAR Sensing and Descriptor-Space Retrieval RLRobot

3D global relocalization synthetic LiDAR sensing descriptor-space retrieval offline-online hierarchical framework point cloud registration

简要说明：提出了一种基于合成LiDAR感知和描述符空间检索的离线-在线分层框架，用于实现快速的三维全局机器人重定位。

TLDR: Proposes an offline-online hierarchical framework for fast 3D global robot relocalization using synthetic LiDAR sensing and descriptor-space retrieval.

Abstract: 3D global relocalization is one of the key capabilities for mobile robots in practical applications. However, in large scale spaces, existing methods often suffer from prolonged online relocalization time due to factors such as the massive pose search space and high computational overhead. To address these issues, this paper proposes an offline-online hierarchical framework that decouples the search space. In the offline phase, candidate positions and their corresponding geometric descriptor indices are generated in the map by simulating LiDAR scans within the grid map. In the online phase, a coarse pose estimate is first obtained via global retrieval, followed by point cloud registration to output precise 6-DoF pose estimates. Real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an average relocalization time of 3 s and an average localization accuracy of 8 cm in 3D environments. Compared with existing global relocalization methods, the proposed method achieves an order-of-magnitude improvement in computational efficiency while delivering comparable relocalization accuracy.

摘要（中文）：三维全局重定位是移动机器人实际应用中的关键能力之一。然而在大规模场景中，现有方法常因位姿搜索空间庞大、计算开销高等因素导致在线重定位时间过长。为解决该问题，本文提出一种解耦搜索空间的离线-在线分层框架：离线阶段通过在栅格地图中模拟激光雷达扫描，生成地图中的候选位置及其对应的几何描述子索引；在线阶段先通过全局检索获取粗粒度位姿估计，再通过点云配准输出精确的六自由度位姿估计。真实场景实验表明，该方法在三维环境中平均重定位时间为3秒、平均定位精度达8厘米。与现有全局重定位方法相比，所提方法在保持相当重定位精度的同时，实现了计算效率的数量级提升。

Authors: Jiahua Ren, Kai Shen, Muhua Zhang, Lei Ma

Drifting Field Policy: A One-Step Generative Policy via Wasserstein Gradient Flow Manipulation

generative policy Wasserstein gradient flow non-ODE one-step inference manipulation

简要说明：提出漂移场策略（DFP），一种基于Wasserstein梯度流的非ODE单步生成策略，用于机器人操作，在多个基准测试中取得最先进性能。

TLDR: Proposes Drifting Field Policy (DFP), a non-ODE one-step generative policy for robotic manipulation that frames policy updates as a Wasserstein gradient flow, achieving state-of-the-art results on Robomimic and OGBench.

Abstract: We propose Drifting Field Policy (DFP), a non-ODE one-step generative policy built on the drifting model paradigm. We frame the policy update as a reverse-KL Wasserstein-2 gradient flow toward a soft target policy, so that each DFP update corresponds to a gradient step in probability space. By construction, this gradient is decomposed into an ascent toward higher action-value regions and a score matching with the anchor policy as a trust region. We further derive a simple, tractable surrogate of the otherwise intractable update loss, akin to behavior cloning on top-K critic-selected actions. We find empirically that this mechanism uniquely benefits the drifting backbone owing to its non-ODE parameterization. With one-step inference, DFP achieves state-of-the-art performance on several manipulation tasks across Robomimic and OGBench, outperforming ODE-based policies.

摘要（中文）：本文提出一种基于漂移模型范式的非ODE单步生成策略——漂移场策略（DFP）。我们将策略更新过程构建为朝软目标策略方向的反向KL Wasserstein-2梯度流，从而使每次DFP更新对应概率空间中的梯度步进。该梯度在构造上可分解为：向高动作价值区域的正向攀升，以及以锚定策略作为置信域的得分匹配项。通过推导，我们进一步获得了原不可解更新损失的简洁可计算替代形式，其机制类似于在批评器筛选的Top-K动作上进行行为克隆。实证研究表明，该机制因其非ODE参数化特性而独特地适配漂移框架。通过单步推理，DFP在Robomimic和OGBench的多个操控任务中实现了最先进的性能表现，超越了基于ODE的策略。

Authors: Juil Koo, Mingue Park, Jiwon Choi, Yunhong Min, Minhyuk Sung

PhySPRING: Structure-Preserving Reduction of Physics-Informed Twins via GNN WorldModel

digital twins graph neural networks spring-mass systems complexity reduction physics-informed

简要说明：PhySPRING提出了一种基于GNN的方法，用于减少基于物理的弹簧-质量数字孪生的复杂性，在保持物理保真度的同时加速前向动力学，并展示了其在机器人策略评估中的实用性。

TLDR: PhySPRING introduces a GNN-based method to reduce the complexity of physics-based digital twins built as spring-mass systems, preserving physical fidelity while accelerating forward dynamics, and demonstrates utility in robot policy evaluation.

Abstract: Physics-based digital twins aim to predict the dynamics of real-world objects under interaction, enabling real-to-sim-to-real applications in robotics. Current approaches reconstruct such twins as explicit physical models (such as spring-mass systems) to predict the dynamics, but the resulting models often inherit the resolution of the visual reconstruction rather than being reduced to the physical complexity required to reproduce task-relevant dynamics. This mismatch introduces redundant topology, making repeated forward-dynamics rollouts unnecessarily expensive. To address this challenge, we present PhySPRING, an fully differentiable GNN-based method to reduce complexity in spring--mass digital twins. PhySPRING jointly learns a hierarchy of coarsened graph topologies and their mechanical parameters from observations. At each reduction level, PhySPRING merges nodes with similar learned dynamic responses to optimize the topology, while maintaining every reduced layer as an explicit spring--mass system. On the PhysTwin benchmark, PhySPRING improves dense reconstruction and prediction accuracy over PhysTwin, while reduced models retain stable physical and visual fidelity with up to a 2.30 times speed-up. We further demonstrate the effectiveness of PhySPRING in a Real2Sim robot policy-evaluation pipeline, where the reduced models are substituted zero-shot into ACT and $π_0$ evaluations, maintaining comparable manipulation success rates across downsampling levels while improving action-sampling effectiveness. Together, PhySPRING enables efficient and structure-preserving spring--mass reduction without sacrificing fidelity or robotic utility.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 基于物理的数字孪生旨在预测真实世界物体在交互作用下的动态行为，从而实现机器人领域的“真实-仿真-真实”应用闭环。当前方法通常将此类孪生系统重建为显式物理模型（如弹簧-质点系统）以预测动力学，但所得模型往往沿用了视觉重建的分辨率，未能简化为重现任务相关动态所需的物理复杂度。这种不匹配引入了冗余拓扑结构，导致重复的前向动力学推演计算代价过高。为应对这一挑战，我们提出PhySPRING——一种完全可微分的、基于图神经网络的弹簧-质点数字孪生复杂度简化方法。PhySPRING能够从观测数据中联合学习多层级粗化图拓扑结构及其力学参数。在每一简化层级中，该方法通过合并具有相似学习动态响应的节点来优化拓扑，同时保持每一简化层均为显式弹簧-质点系统。在PhysTwin基准测试中，PhySPRING较原PhysTwin方法提升了密集重建与预测精度，简化后的模型在保持稳定物理与视觉保真度的同时，最高可获得2.30倍的加速比。我们进一步在Real2Sim机器人策略评估流程中验证了PhySPRING的有效性：将简化模型零样本替换至ACT与$π_0$评估框架中，在不同降采样层级下均保持可比拟的操作成功率，同时提升了动作采样效率。综上，PhySPRING在不牺牲保真度或机器人实用性的前提下，实现了高效且保持结构特征的弹簧-质点模型简化。

Authors: Yixiong Jing, Xingyuan Chen, Guangming Wang, Olaf Wysocki, Haibing Wu, Brian Sheil

PathPainter: Transferring the Generalization Ability of Image Generation Models to Embodied Navigation VLN

BEV navigation cross-view localization image generation model traversability masks long-range UAV

简要说明：该论文提出一种导航系统，利用基础图像生成模型理解自然语言并生成BEV可通行性地图，然后采用跨视角定位来校正机器人里程计，实现了无人机的户外长距离导航。

TLDR: This paper proposes a navigation system that uses a foundation image generation model to interpret natural language and generate BEV traversability maps, then employs cross-view localization to align robot odometry for long-range outdoor UAV navigation.

Abstract: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) images have been widely demonstrated to provide valuable prior information for navigation. Given the global information provided by such views, two key challenges remain: how to fully exploit this information and how to reliably use it during execution. In this paper, we propose a navigation system that uses BEV images as global priors and is designed for ground and near-ground robotic platforms. The system employs an image generation model to interpret human intent from natural language, identify the target destination, and generate traversability masks. During execution, we introduce cross-view localization to align the robot's odometry with the BEV map and mitigate long-term drift in conventional odometry. We conduct extensive benchmark experiments to evaluate the proposed method and further validate it on a UAV platform. Using only a conventional local motion planner, the UAV successfully completes a 160-meter outdoor long-range navigation task. This work demonstrates how the world-understanding capabilities of foundation models can be transferred to embodied navigation, enabling robots to benefit from the strong generalization ability of existing image generation models.

摘要（中文）：鸟瞰图（BEV）图像已被广泛证明能为导航提供有价值的先验信息。尽管此类视图提供了全局信息，仍面临两大关键挑战：如何充分利用这些信息，以及如何在执行过程中可靠地应用这些信息。本文提出一种以BEV图像作为全局先验的导航系统，专为地面及近地面机器人平台设计。该系统采用图像生成模型解读自然语言中的人类意图，识别目标地点，并生成可通行区域掩码。在执行阶段，我们引入跨视角定位技术，将机器人里程计与BEV地图对齐，以抑制传统里程计的长期漂移误差。通过大量基准实验评估所提方法，并在无人机平台上进行进一步验证。仅使用常规局部运动规划器，无人机即成功完成了160米室外长距离导航任务。本研究表明基础模型的世界理解能力可迁移到具身导航领域，使机器人能够受益于现有图像生成模型的强大泛化能力。

Authors: Yijin Wang, Yuru Tian, Xijie Huang, Weiqi Gai, Mo Zhu, Xin Zhou, Yuze Wu, Fei Gao

Weather-Robust Scene Semantics with Vision-Aligned 4D Radar AutonomousDriving

4D radar vision-language model weather-robust scene semantics sensor fusion

简要说明：该研究将4D雷达编码器与冻结的视觉语言模型对齐，以生成天气鲁棒的场景语义描述，在恶劣天气条件下优于相机基线。

TLDR: This paper aligns a 4D radar encoder to frozen vision-language embeddings to produce weather-robust scene captions, outperforming camera baselines in adverse conditions.

Abstract: Cameras and LiDAR degrade in rain, fog, and snow, while millimeter-wave radar remains largely unaffected. We align a radar encoder to frozen SigLIP vision embeddings and decode structured scene captions through a frozen vision-language model (VLM) with approximately 7M trainable parameters. On K-RADAR with held-out fog, light snow, and heavy snow sequences, all radar configurations outperform a camera baseline that collapses to over 90% hallucination. We identify a token-norm mismatch as the dominant failure mode when bridging radar to a frozen VLM and show that projector-output LayerNorm resolves it. Analysis of encoder complexity, caption format, and pooling strategy reveals tradeoffs that inform future radar-VLM pipeline design.

摘要（中文）：摄像头与激光雷达在雨、雾、雪等天气下性能会显著下降，而毫米波雷达基本不受影响。我们将雷达编码器与冻结的SigLIP视觉嵌入对齐，并通过一个约含700万可训练参数的冻结视觉语言模型（VLM）解码结构化场景描述。在K-RADAR数据集包含的雾、小雪及大雪场景测试序列中，所有雷达配置方案均优于摄像头基线方案——后者在超过90%的案例中出现了幻觉性错误。研究发现，将雷达数据接入冻结VLM时，令牌范数不匹配是主要失效模式，并证明投影器输出层的归一化处理可有效解决该问题。通过对编码器复杂度、描述格式及池化策略的分析，揭示了不同设计间的权衡关系，为未来雷达-VLM融合系统的设计提供了参考依据。

Authors: Kali Hamilton, Christoffer Heckman

BioProVLA-Agent: An Affordable, Protocol-Driven, Vision-Enhanced VLA-Enabled Embodied Multi-Agent System with Closed-Loop-Capable Reasoning for Biological Laboratory Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) embodied multi-agent system protocol-driven closed-loop verification biological laboratory manipulation

简要说明：本文提出BioProVLA-Agent，一个用于生物实验室操作的、经济实惠的多智能体系统，它利用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，具备闭环验证能力，并针对湿实验室的视觉干扰设计了在线增强策略。

TLDR: This paper presents BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, multi-agent system for biological laboratory manipulation using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, with closed-loop verification and an online augmentation strategy for wet-lab visual challenges.

Abstract: Biological laboratory automation can reduce repetitive manual work and improve reproducibility, but reliable embodied execution in wet-lab environments remains challenging. Protocols are often unstructured, labware is frequently transparent or reflective, and multi-step procedures require state-aware execution beyond one-shot instruction following. Existing robotic systems often rely on costly hardware, fixed workflows, dedicated instruments, or robotics-oriented interfaces. Here, we introduce BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, protocol-driven, vision-enhanced embodied multi-agent system enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for biological manipulation. The system uses protocols as the task interface and integrates protocol parsing, visual state verification, and embodied execution in a closed-loop workflow. A Tailored LLM Protocol Agent converts protocols into verifiable subtasks; a VLM-RAG Verification Agent assesses readiness and completion using observations, robot states, retrieved knowledge, and success/failure examples; and a VLA Embodied Agent executes verified subtasks through a lightweight policy. To improve robustness under wet-lab visual perturbations, we develop AugSmolVLA, an online augmentation strategy targeting transparent labware, reflections, illumination shifts, and overexposure. We evaluate the system on a hierarchical benchmark covering 15 atomic tasks, 6 composite workflows, and 3 bimanual tasks, including tube loading, sorting, waste disposal, cap twisting, and liquid pouring. Across normal and high-exposure settings, AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes. These results suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.

摘要（中文）：生物实验室自动化能够减少重复性手动工作并提升实验可重复性，但在湿实验室环境中实现可靠的具身操作仍然面临挑战。实验方案通常缺乏结构化特征，实验器皿常具有透明或反光属性，且多步骤操作流程需要超越单次指令执行的状态感知能力。现有机器人系统往往依赖昂贵硬件、固定工作流程、专用仪器或面向机器人的定制界面。本文提出BioProVLA-Agent——一种基于视觉语言动作（VLA）模型构建的经济型、协议驱动、视觉增强型具身多智能体系统，专为生物实验操作设计。该系统以实验方案作为任务接口，将协议解析、视觉状态验证与具身操作整合于闭环工作流中：定制化的LLM协议代理将实验方案转化为可验证的子任务；VLM-RAG验证代理通过观察数据、机器人状态、检索知识及成功/失败案例评估任务就绪度与完成度；VLA具身代理则通过轻量化策略执行已验证的子任务。为提升湿实验室视觉干扰环境下的鲁棒性，我们研发了AugSmolVLA在线增强策略，专门针对透明器皿、反光现象、光照变化及过曝场景进行优化。该系统在包含15项基础任务、6项复合流程及3项双手操作任务的层级化基准测试中接受评估，涵盖试管装载、分拣、废液处理、瓶盖旋转及液体倾倒等操作。在正常与高曝光环境中，AugSmolVLA相较ACT、X-VLA及原始SmolVLA模型均展现出更强的执行稳定性，尤其在精准定位、透明物体操作、复合工作流及视觉退化场景中表现突出。这些成果为开发生物实验操作领域可普及、以协议为中心、具备验证能力的具身人工智能提供了切实可行的技术路径。

Authors: Zhaohui Du, Zhe Wang, Hongmei Fei, Xiwen Cao, Ting Xiao, Qi Wang, Huanbo Jin, Jiaming Gu, Quan Lu, Zhe Liu

Palm-sized Omnidirectional Vision-Based UAV Exploration with Sparse Topological Map Guidance VLN

autonomous exploration topological map omnidirectional vision UAV depth estimation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于微型无人机的轻量级自主探索系统，利用全方位视觉和稀疏拓扑地图，以极低计算消耗实现高效的边界检测和路径规划。

TLDR: This paper presents a lightweight autonomous exploration system for micro UAVs using omnidirectional vision and sparse topological maps to enable efficient frontier detection and path planning with low computational consumption.

Abstract: Classic exploration methods often rely on dense occupancy maps or high-resolution point clouds for frontier detection and path planning, resulting in substantial memory consumption and computational overhead. Moreover, micro UAVs under size, weight, and power (SWaP) constraints are not practical to be equipped with sensors like LiDAR to obtain accurate environmental geometric measurements. This paper presents a lightweight autonomous exploration system that leverages omnidirectional vision and sparse topological map guidance. Specifically, we utilize a multi-fisheye camera setup to achieve omnidirectional Field of View (FoV) and perform depth estimation. To address the limited depth estimation accuracy, frontiers are represented as potential unexplored regions characterized by topological nodes instead of explicit boundaries, enabling efficient identification of frontier regions without maintaining occupancy grids or global point clouds. Unlike classic dense representations, our approach abstracts the environment using a sparse topological map composed of key nodes and their descriptors, reducing memory consumption and computational demands. Global path planning is performed directly on the sparse graph. The proposed method is validated in both simulation and on a palm-sized vision-based UAV with an 11 cm wheelbase and a 400 g weight in real-world experiments, demonstrating that our method can achieve efficient exploration with extremely low computational consumption.

摘要（中文）：传统探索方法通常依赖密集占据地图或高分辨率点云进行边界检测与路径规划，这导致显著的内存消耗与计算开销。此外，受尺寸、重量和功耗限制的微型无人机难以配备激光雷达等传感器来获取精确的环境几何测量数据。本文提出一种轻量级自主探索系统，该系统利用全景视觉与稀疏拓扑地图引导。具体而言，我们采用多鱼眼相机配置实现全景视野并执行深度估计。针对深度估计精度受限的问题，将边界表示为以拓扑节点为特征而非显式边界的潜在未探索区域，从而无需维护占据栅格或全局点云即可高效识别边界区域。与传统的密集表示方法不同，我们的方法通过由关键节点及其描述符构成的稀疏拓扑地图对环境进行抽象表示，显著降低了内存消耗与计算需求。全局路径规划直接在稀疏图结构上执行。所提出的方法在仿真实验和真实场景中均得到验证，测试平台为轴距11厘米、重量400克的手掌级视觉无人机。实验结果表明，该方法能以极低计算消耗实现高效探索。

Authors: Zirui Wang, Xinjia Luo, Haotian Sun, Jun Ma, Jian Guo, Boyu Zhou

PISTO: Proximal Inference for Stochastic Trajectory Optimization RLRobot

Stochastic Trajectory Optimization Variational Inference KL Regularization Robot Motion Planning Derivative-Free Optimization

简要说明：提出PISTO，一种用于随机轨迹优化的近端推理算法，通过KL正则化稳定更新，实现了对不可微成本的无导数规划，并在机器人运动规划和接触丰富的任务中展现了更好的性能。

TLDR: Proposes PISTO, a proximal inference algorithm for stochastic trajectory optimization that stabilizes updates via KL regularization, enabling derivative-free planning for non-differentiable costs and demonstrating improved performance on robot motion planning and contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: Stochastic trajectory optimization methods like STOMP enable planning with non-differentiable costs, offering substantial flexibility over gradient-based approaches. We show that STOMP implicitly minimizes the KL divergence from a Boltzmann trajectory distribution, revealing an elegant Variational Inference (VI) structure underlying its updates. Building on this insight, we propose the \textit{Proximal Inference for Stochastic Trajectory Optimization} (PISTO) algorithm that stabilizes the updates by augmenting the objective with a KL regularization between successive Gaussian proposals. This proximal formulation admits a trust-region interpretation and yields closed-form mean updates computable as expectations under a surrogate distribution. We estimate these expectations via importance-weighted Monte Carlo sampling, producing a simple, derivative-free algorithm that inherits STOMP's ability to handle non-differentiable and discontinuous costs without modification. On robot arm motion planning benchmarks, PISTO achieves an 89\% success rate -- outperforming CHOMP (63\%) and STOMP (68\%) -- while producing shorter, smoother paths at twice the speed of competing stochastic methods. We further validate PISTO on contact-rich MuJoCo locomotion and manipulation tasks, where it consistently outperforms both CEM and MPPI baselines in reward.

摘要（中文）：诸如STOMP的随机轨迹优化方法能够规划不可微成本，相比基于梯度的方法提供了极大的灵活性。我们指出STOMP隐含地最小化玻尔兹曼轨迹分布的KL散度，从而揭示了其更新过程中蕴含的变分推断（VI）结构。基于这一洞察，我们提出了\textit{随机轨迹优化的近端推断}（PISTO）算法，通过在当前高斯建议分布与上一时刻建议分布之间增加KL正则化项来稳定更新过程。该近端框架具有信赖域的理论解释，并产生可计算的闭式均值更新，这些更新可表示为在替代分布下的期望值。我们通过重要性加权蒙特卡洛采样对这些期望进行估计，从而得到一个简单、无需求导的算法，该算法继承了STOMP无需修改即可处理不可微与不连续成本的能力。在机器人手臂运动规划基准测试中，PISTO实现了89\%的成功率——优于CHOMP（63\%）和STOMP（68\%）——同时以两倍于竞争性随机方法的速度生成更短、更平滑的路径。我们进一步在接触丰富的MuJoCo运动与操作任务中验证PISTO，其奖励表现始终优于CEM和MPPI基线方法。

Authors: Hongzhe Yu, Zinuo Chang, Yongxin Chen

Learning Material-Aware Hamiltonian Risk Fields for Safe Navigation AutonomousDriving

risk-aware navigation port-Hamiltonian policy context-energy term CVaR objective selective maneuver activation

简要说明：该论文提出为端口-哈密顿导航策略学习一个上下文能量项，以选择性激活规避动作，仅当存在低风险可行方向时才触发，并在越野地形和高速公路场景中进行了验证。

TLDR: The paper proposes learning a context-energy term for port-Hamiltonian navigation policies to selectively activate evasive maneuvers only when lower-risk feasible directions exist, validated on off-road terrain and highway scenarios.

Abstract: Risk-aware navigation should be selective: a policy should expose evasive degrees of freedom only when the local scene admits a lower-risk feasible maneuver, and suppress them when no safer alternative exists. We show that adding one context-energy term to a port-Hamiltonian navigation policy produces a learned force channel with exactly this falsifiable signature. When the local risk field contains a feasible lower-risk direction, the induced context force activates toward it; when the apparent escape is blocked or not yet available, a route-aware gate suppresses lateral force rather than hallucinating an unsafe maneuver. A CVaR tail-risk objective focuses gradient updates on rare but consequential risk transitions. We validate the selectivity signature across four settings. In the primary delayed-required-escape benchmark, route-aware CVaR reduces premature force activation from 0.950 to 0.180 versus DWA while raising success from 0.480 to 0.810 with zero replans. On real off-road terrain (RELLIS-3D), route-aware enrichment achieves correct activation rate 0.837 and false activation rate 0.114, compared to 0.378/0.752 for scalar risk gradients. On static semantic maps (DFC2018), enrichment reduces catastrophic failure from 0.60 to 0.10 and oscillation by 90.7% while preserving path efficiency. In highway traffic, collisions drop from 100% to 0% when a lane escape is feasible; when no escape exists, the policy suppresses the lateral maneuver. The selectivity property follows from the gradient structure of the context energy rather than from training-time tuning.

摘要（中文）：风险感知导航应具备选择性：当局部场景存在低风险可行机动时，策略应开放规避自由度；当不存在更安全的替代方案时，则应抑制这些自由度。我们证明，在端口哈密顿导航策略中添加一个上下文能量项可生成具有明确可验证特征的学习力通道。当局部风险场存在可行的低风险方向时，诱导的上下文力将向其激活；当明显逃逸路径受阻或尚未出现时，路径感知门会抑制横向力，而非臆造不安全机动。通过条件风险价值尾部风险目标，梯度更新聚焦于罕见但具有重大影响的风险转换。我们在四种场景中验证了该选择性特征：在延迟必需逃逸基准测试中，相比动态窗口法，路径感知条件风险价值将过早力激活从0.950降至0.180，同时将成功率从0.480提升至0.810且无需重新规划；在真实越野地形（RELLIS-3D）中，路径感知增强实现0.837的正确激活率与0.114的错误激活率，而标量风险梯度法对应值仅为0.378/0.752；在静态语义地图（DFC2018）中，增强方法将灾难性故障从0.60降至0.10，振荡减少90.7%，同时保持路径效率；在高速公路交通场景中，当车道逃逸可行时碰撞率从100%降至0%，若无逃逸路径则策略抑制横向机动。该选择特性源于上下文能量的梯度结构，而非训练阶段的调参结果。

Authors: Aditya Sai Ellendula, Yi Wang, Chandrajit Bajaj

Intention assimilation control for accurate tracking with variable impedance in teleoperation Manipulation

teleoperation variable impedance control intention assimilation tracking accuracy bilateral control

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于遥操作中的意图同化控制策略，通过估计领导者的目标位置，在无需高刚度的条件下实现高跟踪精度，并实现变阻抗控制。该策略在7自由度机械臂上进行了验证，相比遥阻抗控制，在精度、任务完成率和完成时间上均有所提升。

TLDR: The paper introduces an intention assimilation control strategy for teleoperation that estimates the leader's target position to achieve high tracking accuracy without requiring high stiffness, enabling variable impedance control. It was validated on 7-DoF manipulators, showing improved accuracy, task completion, and completion time compared to tele-impedance control.

Abstract: Robot systems for teleoperation commonly use a spring-like force pulling the follower robot towards the leader's position to track their movements. With this control strategy, the tracking accuracy deteriorates when the follower' stiffness is low, but high stiffness poses a danger to objects or people in the follower robot's environment. To address this trade-off between tracking accuracy and safety, we propose an alternative intention assimilation control (IAC) strategy where the robot's tracking accuracy can be ensured without high stiffness. Different from traditional approaches, which transmit the leader's current position to the follower, this new controller estimates the leader's target position and transmits it to the follower. With this strategy, the follower impedance can be changed on-the-fly to continuously reflect the user's desired impedance or modulated automatically to fulfill the task requirements. Our controller was validated on two 7 degree-of-freedom manipulators, yielding high tracking accuracy with varying impedance. Four experiments were conducted to compare {teleoperation} with IAC to tele-impedance control (TIC) during free tracking, interaction with a balloon, during peg insertion, and table polishing with force feedback. The results show that IAC increases tracking accuracy, improves task completion rate and reduces completion time. IAC enables the robot to accurately replicate the user's movement while giving them freedom to modulate the impedance according to their intention, providing an unprecedented level of control of the follower's position and its impedance during unilateral and bilateral teleoperation.

摘要（中文）：远程操作机器人系统通常采用类弹簧力驱动从动机器人追踪主动机器人的位置，以实现运动同步。在此控制策略下，当从动机器人刚度较低时跟踪精度会下降，而高刚度则会对环境中的人或物体构成安全隐患。为平衡跟踪精度与安全性之间的制约关系，我们提出一种新型的意图同化控制策略，该策略可在不依赖高刚度的前提下保证机器人的跟踪精度。与传统方法直接传输主动端当前位置不同，新控制器通过估计主动端的目标位置并传输至从动端。基于此策略，从动端阻抗可实时调整以持续反映用户的期望阻抗，或根据任务需求进行自动调节。我们在两台七自由度机械臂上验证了该控制器，实现了变阻抗条件下的高精度跟踪。通过自由空间跟踪、气球交互、轴孔装配及带力反馈的桌面抛光四项实验，对比了意图同化控制与远程阻抗控制在远程操作中的表现。实验结果表明，意图同化控制显著提升了跟踪精度、任务完成率并缩短了作业时间。该策略使机器人能够精确复现用户动作，同时允许用户根据意图自由调节阻抗，在单向与双向远程操作中实现了对从动端位置与阻抗前所未有的控制水平。
