Authors: Atsushi Takagi, Yanan Li, Hiroaki Gomi, Etienne Burdet

AirBender: Adaptive Transportation of Bendable Objects Using Dual UAVs Manipulation

aerial manipulation adaptive control bendable object dual UAV Lyapunov analysis

简要说明：本文提出了一种自适应控制器，使两个无人机无需依赖显式弹性模型即可协作运输可弯曲物体，通过李雅普诺夫分析确保了渐近稳定性，并在硬件实验中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an adaptive controller for dual UAVs to collaboratively transport bendable objects without explicit elasticity models, ensuring asymptotic stability via Lyapunov analysis and validated in hardware experiments.

Abstract: The interaction of robots with bendable objects in midair presents significant challenges in control, often resulting in performance degradation and potential crashes, especially for aerial robots due to their limited actuation capabilities and constant need to remain airborne. This paper presents an adaptive controller that enables two aerial vehicles to collaboratively follow a trajectory while transporting a bendable object without relying on explicit elasticity models. Our method allows on-the-fly adaptation to the object's unknown deformable properties, ensuring stability and performance in trajectory-tracking tasks. We use Lyapunov analysis to demonstrate that our adaptive controller is asymptotically stable. Our method is evaluated through hardware experiments in various scenarios, demonstrating the capabilities of using multirotor aerial vehicles to handle bendable objects.

摘要（中文）：机器人与可弯曲物体在半空中的交互在控制上带来了显著挑战，常导致性能下降乃至潜在碰撞风险，特别是对于驱动能力有限且需持续保持飞行状态的空中机器人而言。本文提出一种自适应控制器，使两架飞行器能够在运输可弯曲物体时协同跟踪轨迹，且无需依赖显式弹性模型。该方法可实时适应物体未知的形变特性，确保轨迹跟踪任务中的稳定性和性能。我们通过李雅普诺夫分析证明了该自适应控制器具有渐近稳定性，并在多种场景下通过硬件实验对该方法进行了评估，展示了多旋翼飞行器处理可弯曲物体的能力。

Authors: Jiawei Xu, Longsen Gao, Rafael Fierro, David Saldaña

Sword: Style-Robust World Models as Simulators via Dynamic Latent Bootstrapping for VLA Policy Post-Training WorldModel

World Models VLA policy post-training Style Augmentation Dynamic Latent Bootstrapping LIBERO benchmark

简要说明：提出Sword，一个稳健的世界模型框架，通过结构引导的风格增强和动态潜在自举，提升在机器人环境中VLA策略后训练的泛化性和保真度。

TLDR: Proposes Sword, a robust World Model framework with Structure-Guided Style Augmentation and Dynamic Latent Bootstrapping to improve generalization and fidelity for VLA policy post-training in robotic environments.

Abstract: The integration of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with World Models has gained increasing attention. One representative approach treats learned World Models as generative simulators, enabling policy optimization entirely within "imagination." However, when deployed as simulators for specific environments such as the LIBERO benchmark, existing World Models often suffer from poor generalization and long-horizon error accumulation. During closed-loop rollouts, these models are highly sensitive to initial-state perturbations; minor changes in color, illumination, and other visual factors can trigger cascading hallucinations, leading to severe blurriness or overexposure. Moreover, long-horizon error accumulation further degrades the quality and fidelity of predicted future states. These issues limit the reliability of World Models as simulators. To mitigate these problems, we propose Sword, a robust World Model framework. Our method introduces Structure-Guided Style Augmentation to disentangle the visual textures of interactive environments from task-relevant dynamics, thereby improving generalization. We further propose Dynamic Latent Bootstrapping, which maintains consistency between training and inference while keeping memory consumption low. Extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark show that our method significantly outperforms the baseline WoVR in terms of generalization, generation quality, robustness, fidelity, and the success rate of reinforcement-learning post-training for VLA models.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界模型的融合日益受到关注。一种代表性方法将学习得到的世界模型视为生成式模拟器，实现完全在“想象”中进行策略优化。然而，当作为特定环境（如LIBERO基准测试）的模拟器部署时，现有世界模型往往存在泛化能力差和长时程误差累积问题。在闭环推演过程中，这些模型对初始状态扰动极为敏感；颜色、光照等视觉因素的微小变化可能引发级联幻觉，导致严重的模糊或过度曝光。此外，长时程误差累积会进一步降低预测未来状态的质量与保真度。这些问题限制了世界模型作为模拟器的可靠性。为缓解这些缺陷，我们提出Sword——一个鲁棒的世界模型框架。该方法引入结构引导的风格增强技术，将交互环境的视觉纹理从任务相关动态中解耦，从而提升泛化能力。我们进一步提出动态潜在空间自举方法，在保持较低内存消耗的同时，确保训练与推理的一致性。在LIBERO基准测试上的大量实验表明，本方法在泛化性能、生成质量、鲁棒性、保真度以及VLA模型强化学习后训练成功率方面，均显著优于基线模型WoVR。

Authors: Jiaxuan Gao, Yongjian Guo, Zhong Guan, Wen Huang, Wanlun Ma, Xi Xiao, Junwu Xiong, Sheng Wen

PAMPOS: Causal Transformer-based Trajectory Prediction for Attack-Agnostic Misbehavior Detection in V2X Networks AutonomousDriving

trajectory prediction misbehavior detection V2X networks causal transformer anomaly scoring

简要说明：PAMPOS 是一种基于因果变换器的异常检测方法，通过学习正常车辆轨迹模式并评分偏差来识别 V2X 网络中的篡改攻击，无需攻击标签训练数据。

TLDR: PAMPOS is a causal transformer-based anomaly detection method that identifies falsification attacks in V2X networks by learning normal vehicle trajectory patterns and scoring deviations without requiring attack-labeled training data.

Abstract: Misbehavior detection in Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) networks is a second line of defense against insider falsification attacks that cryptographic mechanisms alone cannot address. Existing learning-based Misbehavior Detection Schemes (MDSs) are supervised, requiring labeled attack samples at training time, thus failing to counter unseen falsification attacks. We present PAMPOS, a causal transformer-decoder trained on benign VeReMi++ trajectories to learn normal mobility patterns. At inference time, misbehavior is identified as a deviation from the model's next-step kinematic predictions using a top-K normalized anomaly scoring mechanism that localizes falsification to specific kinematic features, without requiring attack-labeled training data. We evaluate PAMPOS across all 19 attack types in VeReMi++ under rush-hour and afternoon scenarios, achieving Area Under the Curve (AUC) values of up to 0.98 and F1-scores of up to 0.95 for most attack categories.

摘要（中文）：车辆到一切（V2X）网络中的异常行为检测是抵御内部篡改攻击的第二道防线，仅依赖密码学机制无法应对此类攻击。现有的基于学习的异常行为检测方案（MDSs）多为监督式方法，训练时需要标记的攻击样本，因此难以防范未知的篡改攻击。本文提出PAMPOS——一种基于因果Transformer解码器的模型，该模型通过训练正常的VeReMi++轨迹数据学习合法移动模式。在推理阶段，模型采用基于前K项归一化的异常评分机制，通过检测车辆运动状态与模型下一步运动学预测的偏差来识别异常行为，该机制能够将篡改行为定位到具体运动学特征，且无需依赖攻击标记的训练数据。我们在VeReMi++数据集的所有19种攻击类型中，分别针对高峰时段和午后场景对PAMPOS进行评估，结果显示在多数攻击类别下，该模型的曲线下面积（AUC）最高可达0.98，F1分数最高可达0.95。

Authors: Konstantinos Kalogiannis, Ahmed Mohamed Hussain, Panos Papadimitratos

Probabilistic Object Detection with Conformal Prediction AutonomousDriving

conformal prediction probabilistic object detection uncertainty quantification autonomous driving distribution shift

简要说明：该论文提出了一种用于自动驾驶概率目标检测的保形预测方法，通过使用偶然不确定性估计扩展预测区间并在三个驾驶数据集上验证，改进了不确定性量化。

TLDR: The paper introduces a conformal prediction method for probabilistic object detection in autonomous driving, improving uncertainty quantification by scaling prediction intervals with aleatoric uncertainty estimates and validating on three driving datasets.

Abstract: Conformal Prediction (CP) is a distribution-free method for constructing prediction sets with marginal finite-sample coverage guarantees, making it a suitable framework for reliable uncertainty quantification in safety-critical object detection. However, object detection introduces structured multi-output predictions, complicating the application of classical CP theory developed for single outputs. In addition, standard, unscaled CP produces fixed-width prediction intervals across inputs, leading to unnecessary width for low-uncertainty predictions. While scaled CP addresses this by adapting the interval width to an input-dependent uncertainty estimate, prior work has neither systematically compared unscaled and scaled CP for multi-class object detection, nor integrated CP with a complementary uncertainty quantification method in this setting. We fill this gap by: (i) applying CP coordinate-wise to bounding box corners with a Bonferroni correction for box-level guarantees; (ii) scaling the resulting intervals using per-prediction aleatoric uncertainty estimates derived from a probabilistic object detector trained with loss attenuation, evaluated in uncalibrated and two calibrated variants; (iii) extending to a two-step pipeline that constructs prediction sets for the class using RAPS and conditions the conformalized bounding boxes on the predicted class set. Across three autonomous driving datasets (KITTI, BDD, CODA), including a cross-domain setting under distribution shift, scaled CP consistently improves interval sharpness over unscaled CP, achieving up to 19% higher IoU and 39% lower interval scores, without sacrificing coverage. Class-wise calibration further improves coverage for both variants with a negligible effect on sharpness. Together, these improvements yield more actionable uncertainty estimates for real-time, real-world object detection.

摘要（中文）：保形预测是一种无分布方法，用于构建具有边缘有限样本覆盖保证的预测集，这使其成为安全关键目标检测中可靠不确定性量化的合适框架。然而，目标检测涉及结构化的多输出预测，这使原本为单输出开发的经典保形预测理论的应用变得复杂。此外，标准未缩放的保形预测会生成跨输入的固定宽度预测区间，导致低不确定性预测产生不必要的宽度。虽然缩放保形预测通过根据输入相关的不确定性估计调整区间宽度来解决此问题，但先前研究既未系统比较未缩放和缩放保形预测在多类别目标检测中的效果，也未在此场景下将保形预测与互补的不确定性量化方法相结合。本文通过以下工作填补了这一空白：首先，将保形预测逐坐标应用于边界框角点，并采用邦费罗尼校正以提供边界框级别的保证；其次，利用通过损失衰减训练的概率目标检测器获取的逐预测偶然性不确定性估计对结果区间进行缩放，评估包括未校准和两种校准变体；第三，扩展至两步流程——使用RAPS构建类别预测集，并基于预测类别集对保形化的边界框进行条件化处理。在三个自动驾驶数据集（KITTI、BDD、CODA）上，包括分布偏移下的跨域场景，缩放保形预测相较于未缩放版本持续提升区间锐度，在保持覆盖率的条件下，交并比提升最高达19%，区间评分降低39%。类别校准进一步提高了两种变体的覆盖率，且对锐度影响可忽略。这些改进共同为实时现实世界目标检测提供了更具可操作性的不确定性估计。

Authors: Christopher Ries, Moussa Kassem Sbeyti, Nicolas Bianco, Nadja Klein

UniD-Shift: Towards Unified Semantic Segmentation via Interpretable Share-Private Multimodal Decomposition Perception3D

semantic segmentation multimodal fusion shared-private decomposition cross-modal alignment autonomous driving

简要说明：提出一个统一的多模态2D-3D语义分割框架，通过将特征分解为共享和私有子空间，改善了自动驾驶感知中的跨模态融合和泛化能力。

TLDR: A unified multimodal 2D-3D semantic segmentation framework that decomposes features into shared and private subspaces, improving cross-modal fusion and generalization for autonomous driving perception.

Abstract: Semantic segmentation of large-scale 3D point clouds is crucial for applications such as autonomous driving and urban digital twins. However, the sparse sampling pattern of LiDAR and the view-dependent geometric distortion in image observations complicate cross-modal alignment and hinder stable fusion. Inspired by the fact that 2D images captured by cameras are representations of the 3D world, we recognize that the features learned from 2D and 3D segmentation share some common semantics, while other aspects remain modality-specific. This insight motivates a unified multimodal framework for joint 2D-3D semantic segmentation. We combine a SAM-based vision encoder with a SPTNet-based geometric encoder to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations. The resulting features from both modalities are explicitly decomposed into shared and private subspaces, where the shared components summarize semantic factors common to both domains, and the private components preserve properties that are unique to each modality. A lightweight attention-based fusion module aggregates the shared features into a consistent cross-modal representation, and a regularized training objective ensures both semantic alignment and subspace independence. Experiments on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in segmentation accuracy over representative multimodal baselines, accompanied by competitive computational efficiency. Cross-domain evaluation on nuScenes USA-Singapore shows stable performance under distribution shifts, demonstrating strong generalization. The implementation code is publicly available at: https://github.com/shuaizhang69/UniD-Shift.

摘要（中文）：大规模三维点云的语义分割对于自动驾驶和城市数字孪生等应用至关重要。然而，激光雷达的稀疏采样特性与图像观测中视角依赖的几何畸变使得跨模态对齐复杂化，并阻碍了稳定的融合效果。受摄像头采集的二维图像本质上是三维世界表征这一事实启发，我们认识到从二维与三维分割中学习到的特征既共享部分语义共性，又保留了各自模态的特有属性。基于这一洞见，我们提出了一个统一的二维-三维联合语义分割多模态框架。该框架结合基于SAM的视觉编码器与基于SPTNet的几何编码器，以提取互补的语义与几何表征。两种模态生成的特征被显式分解为共享子空间和私有子空间：共享分量归纳跨域共有语义因子，私有分量则保留各模态独有特性。通过轻量级注意力融合模块将共享特征聚合为一致的跨模态表征，并采用正则化训练目标确保语义对齐与子空间独立性。在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes基准测试上的实验表明，本方法相较于代表性多模态基线模型在分割精度上取得持续提升，同时保持具有竞争力的计算效率。在nuScenes美国-新加坡跨域评估中，模型在分布偏移下表现出稳定的性能，展现出强大的泛化能力。相关实现代码已公开于：https://github.com/shuaizhang69/UniD-Shift。

Authors: Shuai Zhang, Zhecheng Shi, Zhuxiao Li, Jing Ou, Tengxi Wang, Yuan Liu, Wufan Zhao

Melding LLM and temporal logic for reliable human-swarm collaboration in complex scenarios Other

neuro-symbolic temporal logic LLM-based planning human-swarm collaboration heterogeneous swarm

简要说明：一种神经符号框架将大语言模型推理与形式化时序逻辑结合，用于异构机器人集群的可验证任务规划与调度，实现在动态环境中可靠、长期的人-集群协作。

TLDR: A neuro-symbolic framework melds LLM reasoning with formal temporal logic for verifiable task planning and scheduling in heterogeneous robot swarms, enabling reliable long-horizon human-swarm collaboration in dynamic environments.

Abstract: Robot swarms promise scalable assistance in complex and hazardous environments. Task planning lies at the core of human-swarm collaboration, translating the operator's intent into coordinated swarm actions and helping determine when validation or intervention is required during execution. In long-horizon missions under dynamic scenarios, however, reliable task planning becomes difficult to maintain: emerging events and changing conditions demand continual adaptation, and sustained operator oversight imposes substantial cognitive burden. Existing LLM-based planning tools can support plan generation, yet they remain susceptible to invalid task orderings and infeasible robot actions, resulting in frequent manual adjustment. Here we introduce a neuro-symbolic framework for long-horizon human-swarm collaboration that tightly melds verifiable task planning with context-grounded LLM reasoning. We formalize mission goals and operational rules as temporal logic formulas and admissible task orderings as task automata. Conditioned on these formal constraints and live perceptual context, LLMs generate executable subtask sequences that satisfy mission rules and remain grounded in the current scene. An uncertainty-aware scheduler then assigns subtasks across the heterogeneous swarm to maximize parallelisms while remaining resilient to disruptions. An event-triggered interaction protocol further limits operator involvement to sparse, high-level confirmation and guidance. Deployment on a heterogeneous robotic fleet yields similar results while remaining robust to hardware-specific actuation and communication uncertainties. Together, these results support a formal and scalable paradigm for reliable and low-overhead human-swarm collaboration in dynamic environments

摘要（中文）：机器人群体在复杂危险环境中展现出规模化协助的潜力。任务规划作为人机协作的核心，负责将操作者意图转化为群体协调行动，并协助判断执行过程中何时需要验证或干预。然而在动态场景下的长周期任务中，可靠的任务规划难以持续维持：突发事件与变化条件要求持续适应性调整，而操作者的长期监控会带来沉重的认知负担。现有基于大语言模型的规划工具虽能支持计划生成，但仍易产生无效任务序列与不可行的机器人动作，导致频繁的人工调整。本文提出一种用于长周期人机协作的神经符号框架，将可验证的任务规划与情境化大语言模型推理深度融合。我们将任务目标与操作规则形式化为时序逻辑公式，将允许的任务序列定义为任务自动机。基于这些形式化约束与实时感知情境，大语言模型生成满足任务规则且扎根于当前场景的可执行子任务序列。随后，不确定性感知调度器在异构群体中分配子任务，以最大化并行执行效率，同时保持对干扰的鲁棒性。事件触发的交互协议进一步将操作者参与限制在稀疏的高层确认与指导层面。在异构机器人集群上的部署实验表明，该系统在保持对硬件特定执行与通信不确定性的鲁棒性的同时，仍能获得稳定效果。这些成果共同支撑了一种形式化、可扩展的动态环境下人机协作范式，实现可靠性与低操作负荷的平衡。

Authors: Junfeng Chen, Yuxiao Zhu, An Zhuo, Xintong Zhang, Shuo Zhang, Guanghui Wen, Xiwang Dong, Meng Guo, Zhongkui Li

Search-based Robustness Testing of Laptop Refurbishing Robotic Software Manipulation

robustness testing object detection search-based testing multi-objective optimization metamorphic relations

简要说明：提出了PROBE，一种基于搜索的鲁棒性测试方法，利用多目标优化来寻找导致笔记本电脑翻新机器人中使用的物体检测模型故障的最小扰动。

TLDR: Proposes PROBE, a search-based robustness testing approach using multi-objective optimization to find minimal perturbations that cause failures in object detection models used in laptop refurbishing robots.

Abstract: The Danish Technological Institute (DTI) focuses on transferring advanced technologies (including robots) to the industry and the public sector. One key application is laptop refurbishment using specialized robots, aimed at promoting reuse, reducing electronic waste, and supporting the European Circular Economy Action Plan. The software of such robots often includes features that use object detection models to detect objects for various purposes, such as identifying screws for laptop disassembly or detecting stickers to remove them. Ensuring the robustness of such models to small input variations remains a critical challenge, and addressing it is important to avoid potential damage to laptops during refurbishment. In this paper, we propose PROBE, a search-based robustness testing approach that leverages multi-objective optimization to identify minimal, localized perturbations that expose failures in object detection models used in the software of laptop refurbishing robots. PROBE employs NSGA-II to systematically explore the perturbation space, optimizing for failure induction considering both localization and confidence, and perturbation magnitude, while enabling the discovery of diverse failure cases. Results show that PROBE is 3$\times$ to 7$\times$ more effective than random search in generating failure-inducing perturbations, while requiring smaller perturbation magnitudes, and that the generated perturbations transfer across models. We further show that metamorphic relations provide additional insights into model robustness, enabling the assessment of stability even in non-failing cases.

摘要（中文）：丹麦技术研究所致力于将先进技术（包括机器人）推广至工业界和公共部门。一个关键应用是使用专业机器人进行笔记本电脑翻新，旨在促进产品再利用、减少电子废弃物，并支持欧洲循环经济行动计划。这类机器人的软件通常包含利用目标检测模型来识别不同物体的功能，例如检测用于拆卸笔记本电脑的螺丝或识别需移除的贴纸。确保此类模型对输入微小变化的鲁棒性仍是一个关键挑战，解决这一问题对于避免翻新过程中可能对笔记本电脑造成的损害至关重要。本文提出了PROBE方法——一种基于搜索的鲁棒性测试方法，该方法利用多目标优化来识别最小化、局部化的扰动，以暴露笔记本电脑翻新机器人软件中目标检测模型的故障。PROBE采用NSGA-II算法系统性地探索扰动空间，同时考虑定位与置信度、扰动幅度来优化故障诱导，并能发现多样化的故障案例。结果表明，在生成诱发故障的扰动方面，PROBE比随机搜索的效果高出3至7倍，且所需扰动幅度更小，同时生成的扰动在不同模型间具有可迁移性。我们进一步证明，蜕变关系能够为模型鲁棒性提供更多洞见，即使在不发生故障的情况下也能评估其稳定性。

Authors: Erblin Isaku, Hassan Sartaj, Shaukat Ali, Malaika Din Hashmi, Francois Picard

Dr-BA: Separable Optimization for Direct Radar Bundle Adjustment & Localization AutonomousDriving

radar bundle adjustment direct localization spinning radar sensor poses dense maps

简要说明：本文提出了Dr-BA，一种用于直接雷达光束法平差和定位的可分离优化框架，利用2D旋转雷达强度图像，在自主系统中实现了最先进的BA和跨时段定位性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces Dr-BA, a separable optimization framework for direct radar bundle adjustment and localization using 2D spinning radar intensity images, achieving state-of-the-art BA and cross-session localization performance for autonomous systems.

Abstract: This paper introduces Dr-BA, a first-of-its-kind radar bundle adjustment (BA) framework that operates directly on 2D spinning radar intensity images. Unlike camera or lidar sensors, radar is largely unaffected by precipitation, making it a critical modality for autonomous systems that require all-weather robustness. Existing state estimation approaches using spinning radar typically extract sparse point clouds from range-azimuth-intensity measurements and apply point cloud alignment techniques to estimate vehicle motion, scene structure, or to localize within an existing map. In contrast, Dr-BA uses the full radar returns from multiple scans to jointly estimate dense maps and sensor poses. By formulating the problem as a separable optimization, we derive an efficient and general solution that decouples pose estimation from mapping. In addition to solving the BA problem, this formulation naturally extends to direct radar-only localization (DRL) within a previously built map. Dr-BA achieves state-of-the-art radar-based BA and cross-session localization performance, demonstrated on more than 200 km of on-road data across five distinct routes. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/utiasASRL/dr_ba.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了Dr-BA——首个直接在二维旋转雷达强度图像上运行的雷达束调整（BA）框架。与传统相机或激光雷达传感器不同，雷达基本不受降水影响，这使其成为自动驾驶系统中实现全天候鲁棒性的关键模态。现有基于旋转雷达的状态估计方法通常从距离-方位-强度测量值中提取稀疏点云，并应用点云配准技术来估计车辆运动、场景结构或在已有地图中定位。与之相对，Dr-BA利用多帧扫描的完整雷达回波数据，联合估计稠密地图与传感器位姿。通过将问题建模为可分离优化，我们推导出一种高效通用解法，实现位姿估计与建图过程的解耦。除了解决BA问题，该框架还可自然扩展至先前构建地图中的直接纯雷达定位（DRL）。Dr-BA在基于雷达的BA与跨会话定位任务中取得了最先进的性能，该结论通过在五条不同路线累计超过200公里的实际道路数据中得到验证。我们的实现代码已开源：https://github.com/utiasASRL/dr_ba。

Authors: Daniil Lisus, Cedric Le Gentil, Timothy D. Barfoot

Bi3: A Biplatform, Bicultural, Biperson Dataset for Social Robot Navigation Other

social robot navigation human motion prediction robot control policies multimodal dataset crowded spaces

简要说明：本文提出了Bi3数据集，用于社交机器人导航，包含多样化人机交互、多个机器人平台和多模态数据，旨在为拥挤空间中的人类运动预测和机器人控制模型训练提供资源。

TLDR: The paper introduces Bi3, a dataset for social robot navigation featuring diverse human-robot interactions, multiple robot platforms, and multimodal data in constrained environments, aimed at training models for human motion prediction and robot control in crowded spaces.

Abstract: We contribute Bi3, a dataset of social robot navigation among groups of people in a constrained lab space. Compared to prior data collection efforts for social robot navigation, our dataset is unique in that it features: an original experiment design giving rise to close navigation encounters between two humans and a robot; five different navigation algorithms; two different robot platforms; a diverse participant pool of 74 people recruited from two sites in the USA and France; multimodal data streams including 10.5 hours of human and robot ground-truth motion tracks, RGB video, and user impressions over robot performance. Our analysis of the collected dataset through metrics like interaction density and human velocity suggests that Bi3 represents a benchmark of unique diversity and modeling complexity. Bi3 contributes towards understanding how humans and robots can productively mesh their activities in constrained environments, and can be a resource for training models of human motion prediction and robot control policies for navigation in densely crowded spaces.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了Bi3数据集，该数据集记录了机器人在受限实验空间中于人群内导航的行为。与以往社交机器人导航的数据收集工作相比，本数据集的独特之处在于：其原始实验设计促成了两人一机之间的近距离导航交互；涵盖了五种不同的导航算法；采用了两种不同的机器人平台；参与者群体覆盖了来自美国和法国两个地区的74人，具有多样性；同时收集了包括10.5小时的人类与机器人真实运动轨迹、RGB视频以及用户对机器人性能评价在内的多模态数据流。通过对交互密度、人类速度等指标的分析，我们发现Bi3数据集在多样性和建模复杂性方面构成了独特的基准。Bi3不仅有助于理解人类与机器人如何在受限环境中高效协同活动，还可作为训练密集人群场景下人类运动预测模型及机器人导航控制策略的重要资源。

Authors: Andrew Stratton, Phani Teja Singamaneni, Pranav Goyal, Rachid Alami, Christoforos Mavrogiannis

EggHand: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Egocentric Hand Pose Forecasting VLA

egocentric hand pose forecasting multimodal foundation model Vision-Language-Action ego-motion controllable prediction

简要说明：提出EggHand，一个用于从第一人称视角视频预测未来3D手部姿势的多模态基础模型，融合了语义推理和运动建模，以提高精度和鲁棒性。

TLDR: Introduces EggHand, a multimodal foundation model for forecasting future 3D hand poses from egocentric video, integrating semantic reasoning and motion modeling for improved accuracy and robustness.

Abstract: Forecasting future 3D hand pose sequences from egocentric video is essential for understanding human intention and enabling embodied applications such as AR/VR assistance and human-robot interaction. However, this task remains a highly challenging problem because egocentric hand motion is driven by complex human intent, exhibits highly dexterous articulations, and is observed under drastic viewpoint shifts induced by ego-motion. In this work, we introduce EggHand, a foundation-model-based framework for egocentric hand pose forecasting that unifies multimodal semantic reasoning with dynamic motion modeling. Our approach couples an action decoder from a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model, which captures the structured temporal dynamics of hand motion, with an egocentric video-text encoder that provides viewpoint-aware contextual information learned from large-scale first-person video. Together, these components overcome the brittleness of generic visual encoders under ego-motion and enable joint reasoning over motion, context, and high-level intent-without relying on body pose or external tracking. Experiments on the EgoExo4D dataset show that EggHand sets a new state of the art in forecasting accuracy, remains robust under severe ego-motion, and further enables controllable prediction via language-based task prompts. Project page: https://jyoun9.github.io/EggHand

摘要（中文）：从第一人称视角视频中预测未来的三维手部姿态序列，对于理解人类意图以及实现增强现实/虚拟现实辅助和人机交互等具身应用至关重要。然而，该任务仍极具挑战性，因为第一人称手部运动由复杂的人类意图驱动，呈现出高度灵巧的关节活动，并在由自身运动引起的剧烈视角变化下被观察。本研究提出了EggHand框架，这是一个基于基础模型的第一人称手部姿态预测系统，将多模态语义推理与动态运动建模相统一。该方法结合了视觉-语言-动作模型的动作解码器（用于捕捉手部运动的结构化时序动态特性）与第一人称视频-文本编码器（通过大规模第一人称视频学习提供视角感知的上下文信息）。这些组件共同克服了通用视觉编码器在自身运动下的脆弱性，实现了对运动、上下文和高级意图的联合推理，且无需依赖身体姿态或外部跟踪。在EgoExo4D数据集上的实验表明，EggHand在预测精度上取得了新的最优性能，在剧烈自身运动下保持鲁棒性，并可通过基于语言的任务提示实现可控预测。项目页面：https://jyoun9.github.io/EggHand

Authors: Jaeyoung Choi, Hyeondong Kim, Yujin Kim, Daehee Park

ST-Gen4D: Embedding 4D Spatiotemporal Cognition into World Model for 4D Generation WorldModel

4D generation world model spatiotemporal cognition latent diffusion 4D Gaussian

简要说明：提出ST-Gen4D，一个基于世界模型的4D生成框架，它利用4D认知图来指导潜在扩散进行4D高斯生成，强调时空规律性。

TLDR: Proposes ST-Gen4D, a world model-based framework for 4D (3D+time) generation, using a 4D cognition graph to guide latent diffusion for 4D Gaussian generation, emphasizing spatiotemporal regularities.

Abstract: Generative models have achieved success in producing apparently coherent 2D videos, but remain challenging in the physical world due to lack of 4D spatiotemporal scale. Typically, existing 4D generative models directly embed macro scale constraints to enhance overall spatiotemporal consistency. However, these methods only ensure global appearance coherence and fail to reveal the local dynamics of the physical world. Our insight is that global appearance structure and local dynamic topology empower 4D spatiotemporal cognition, thereby enabling 4D generation with spatiotemporal regularities. In this work, we propose ST-Gen4D, a 4D generation framework with 4D spatiotemporal cognition-based world model. Our model is guided by four key designs: 1) Spatiotemporal representation. We encode various modalities into multiple representations as a feature basis. 2) Spatiotemporal cognition. We sculpture these representations into global appearance graph and local dynamic graph, and fuse them via semantic-bridged spatiotemporal fusion to obtain a 4D cognition graph. 3) Spatiotemporal reasoning. We utilize a world model to derive future state based on the 4D cognition. 4) Spatiotemporal generation. We leverage the derived cognition as condition to guide latent diffusion for 4D Gaussian generation. By deeply integrating 4D intrinsic cognition with generative priors, our model guarantees the structural rationality and topological consistency of 4D generation. Moreover, we propose ST-4D datasets by aggregating public 4D datasets and self-built subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our ST-Gen4D across 3D and 4D generation tasks.

摘要（中文）：生成模型已在生成具有明显连贯性的二维视频方面取得成功，但由于缺乏四维时空尺度，在物理世界中仍面临挑战。现有四维生成模型通常直接嵌入宏观尺度约束以增强整体时空一致性，然而这些方法仅能确保全局外观连贯性，无法揭示物理世界的局部动态特性。我们的核心观点是：全局外观结构与局部动态拓扑共同支撑四维时空认知，从而实现具有时空规律的四维生成。本文提出ST-Gen4D——基于四维时空认知世界模型的四维生成框架。该模型遵循四个关键设计：1）时空表征：将多模态信息编码为多重表征作为特征基础；2）时空认知：将表征塑造为全局外观图与局部动态图，通过语义桥接的时空融合得到四维认知图；3）时空推理：运用世界模型基于四维认知推导未来状态；4）时空生成：以推导出的认知为条件引导潜在扩散，实现四维高斯生成。通过将四维内在认知与生成先验深度融合，本模型确保了四维生成的结构合理性与拓扑一致性。此外，我们通过整合公开四维数据集与自建子集构建了ST-4D数据集。大量实验证明，我们的ST-Gen4D在三维与四维生成任务中均具有显著优势。
